plugin_asdk_app_6943a2c078b0819188de39e4.longDescription:
Kick-start your tarot reading right inside ChatGPT. Ask AI Tarot to shuffle digital tarot cards, lay a three-card spread, and return clear, private divination insights—no ads or waiting rooms.

How to Use Tarot in ChatGPT

1. Connect: Connect the Tarot app to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type Commands: Simply type "@" then choose the Tarot app, or type “Tarot” (followed by a space) in the chat box.
3. Create: You are ready to go! Try asking specifically:
"Pull tarot cards for my love life."
"Draw three tarot cards and interpret the spread for my upcoming week."
“Provide a three-card tarot reading on balancing work and health.”

Want to dive deeper? Keep asking follow-ups in chat or open the full app for richer symbolism and saved readings.

“为我的爱情生活抽塔罗牌。”

plugin_asdk_app_6944733e4ddc8191bd617f78.longDescription:
Understand Your Day Through Personalized Astrology

Discover a deeper, more personal way to experience astrology with a fully personalized daily horoscope. Horoscope transforms planetary movements, moon phases, and cosmic shifts into clear insights about your emotions, decisions, and life patterns all calculated from your unique birth data.
No generic predictions. Connect the app, ask for a horoscope and we will create one based on precise planetary positions right now.

Each daily horoscope reading explains:

1. How today’s planetary transits affect your love life, career, health, and relationships
2. A thoughtful daily reflection question to encourage mindfulness and growth
3. What the current moon phase means for your mood, energy, and focus
4. Three key highlights that define the tone of your day
5. Your lucky color of the day

Astrology becomes less abstract and more personal something you can reflect on and apply in your daily life.

Our app is capable generating:

- Personalized daily horoscopes based on planetary transits
- A complete natal (birth) chart calculated from your exact birth details
- Transit charts showing how current cosmic movements interact with your birth chart

All calculations are aligned with real astrological movement ensuring accuracy you can trust.

Connect our app and enjoy:

Truly Personalized Readings
Every insight is tailored to your birth chart, not just your sun sign.

Natal & Transit Charts Made Clear
Explore your astrological blueprint and see how today’s planets influence your life right now.

Focus on Real Life Areas
Love, career, health, and relationships explained in clear, relatable language.

Moon Phase & Lucky Color Tracking
Align your actions with daily cosmic energy.

Daily Reflection Question
One simple question each day to encourage awareness and personal growth.

Simple, Beautiful Design
A clean, modern interface that makes astrology easy to return to every day.

Notice, understand and take action on your life patterns.
plugin_asdk_app_6944733e4ddc8191bd617f78.longDescriptionZh:
通过个性化占星术了解你的一天

通过完全个性化的每日星座运势，探索更深入、更个性化的占星体验方式。星座运势将行星运动、月相和宇宙变化转化为关于您的情绪、决定和生活模式的清晰见解，所有这些都是根据您独特的出生数据计算出来的。
没有通用的预测。连接应用程序，索取星座运势，我们将立即根据精确的行星位置创建一个。

每个每日星座运势解释如下：

1. 今天的行星过境如何影响你的爱情生活、职业、健康和人际关系
2. 一个深思熟虑的日常反思问题，以鼓励正念和成长
3. 当前月相对您的情绪、精力和注意力意味着什么
4. 定义一天基调的三个关键亮点
5.你当天的幸运颜色

占星学变得不再那么抽象，而变得更加个人化，你可以在日常生活中反思和应用。

我们的应用程序能够生成：

- 基于行星过境的个性化每日星座运势
- 根据您的确切出生详细信息计算出的完整出生图
- 行运图显示当前的宇宙运动如何与你的出生图相互作用

所有计算均与真实的占星运动保持一致，确保您可以信赖的准确性。

连接我们的应用程序并享受：

真正的个性化阅读
每一个见解都是根据您的出生图量身定制的，而不仅仅是您的太阳星座。

清晰的出生和转运图表
探索你的占星蓝图，看看今天的行星如何影响你现在的生活。

关注现实生活领域
用清晰、相关的语言解释爱情、职业、健康和人际关系。

月相和幸运色追踪
让你的行动与日常宇宙能量保持一致。

每日反思问题
每天提出一个简单的问题，以鼓励意识和个人成长。

简单、美观的设计
干净、现代的界面，让占星学每天都能轻松回归。

注意、理解你的生活模式并采取行动。

plugin_asdk_app_69fde861d3988191a7157df3.longDescription:
Tarot Reading is an interactive tarot app for personal insight, reflection, and intuitive exploration. Ask a question, choose your preferred tarot spread, pull the cards yourself, and receive a personalized reading based on your question and the cards you draw.

The app supports a one-card pull, two-card spread, three-card spread, and the deeper seven-card Horseshoe spread. Whether you are looking for a quick daily card, clarity around a specific situation, or a more detailed spread reading, Tarot Reading helps you explore the messages, themes, and symbolism of the cards in relation to your question.

Each reading is tailored to your chosen spread and card selection, offering a thoughtful interpretation that can help you reflect on your emotions, choices, relationships, and current circumstances through the lens of tarot.
plugin_asdk_app_69fde861d3988191a7157df3.longDescriptionZh:
塔罗牌解读是一款交互式塔罗牌应用程序，用于个人洞察、反思和直观探索。提出问题，选择您喜欢的塔罗牌排列，自己抽牌，并根据您的问题和您抽到的牌接收个性化的解读。

该应用程序支持一张牌拉牌、两张牌展开、三张牌展开以及更深的七张牌马蹄展开。无论您是在寻找一张快速的每日卡片、对特定情况的清晰说明，还是更详细的扩展阅读，塔罗牌解读都可以帮助您探索与您的问题相关的卡片的信息、主题和象征意义。

每个解读都是根据您选择的牌组和卡片选择量身定制的，提供深思熟虑的解释，可以帮助您通过塔罗牌的镜头反思您的情绪、选择、关系和当前情况。

plugin_asdk_app_69655fed917081918a100b06.longDescription:
Steer Astro creates accurate personalized Vedic Birth Charts, Planetary Transits, Dasha periods, and Panchang, enabling you to get Vedic Astrology insights directly from ChatGPT.

Sign in to Steer Astro to connect and create your profile once, then ask questions about:

Your Birth Chart (Kundali)
- Positions of all 9 planets including Sun, Moon, Mars, and more
- Your rising sign and planetary house placements
- Key indicators revealing your soul's purpose and relationships

Life Timing with Dasha Periods
- Your current planetary period and what it means for you
- When shifts in career, relationships, or personal growth are likely
- How long your current phase will last

Daily Planning with Panchang
- Today's lunar day, nakshatra, and auspicious yogas
- Best windows for important activities
- Times to avoid like Rahu Kaal

Planetary Transits
- How current planetary movements affect your chart
- What's influencing your energy and opportunities right now

Ask questions like:
- "When will I get married?"
- "Is this a good time to change jobs?"
- "Is today a good day to go on a date?"
- "What are my top 3 strengths?"
- "What patterns do I keep repeating?"
- "When is a good time to start my business?"

All calculations use the Swiss Ephemeris for astronomical precision. Your profile is securely stored - create it once and get personalized insights anytime. You can always edit your profile by asking - "Help me edit my profile."

plugin_asdk_app_699eac35bfd481919778eb62.productIntro: TriAstra 在 ChatGPT 中创建了跨越三种传统的个性化出生图和本命星座：西方占星学、吠陀占星学 (Jyotish/Kundli) 和韩国 Saju (韩国四柱/明里)。
plugin_asdk_app_699eac35bfd481919778eb62.productIntroEn: TriAstra creates personalized birth charts and natal horoscopes in ChatGPT across three traditions: Western astrology, Vedic astrology (Jyotish/Kundli), and Korean Saju (Korean Four Pillars/Myeongri).
plugin_asdk_app_699eac35bfd481919778eb62.longDescription:
TriAstra creates personalized birth charts and natal horoscopes in ChatGPT across three traditions: Western astrology, Vedic astrology (Jyotish/Kundli), and Korean Saju (Korean Four Pillars/Myeongri).

Enter your birth date, birth time, and birthplace, then choose the tradition you want to explore. The interactive result highlights the placements and patterns that matter most in your chart and explains the calculation behind them in plain language. If your birth time is unknown, TriAstra keeps the reading to what can still be calculated reliably and leaves out houses, angles, and other time-dependent conclusions. For Saju, biological sex is used only to determine the traditional Daeun direction.

Western and Vedic charts use Swiss Ephemeris astronomical data; Saju follows Korean Myeongri principles. TriAstra is designed for individual natal readings rather than daily forecasts or relationship matching. Results are for reflection and entertainment and are not medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
plugin_asdk_app_699eac35bfd481919778eb62.longDescriptionZh:
TriAstra 在 ChatGPT 中创建了跨越三种传统的个性化出生图和本命星座：西方占星学、吠陀占星学 (Jyotish/Kundli) 和韩国 Saju (韩国四柱/明里)。

输入您的出生日期、出生时间和出生地，然后选择您想要探索的传统。交互式结果突出显示了图表中最重要的位置和模式，并用简单的语言解释了它们背后的计算。如果您的出生时间未知，TriAstra 会将读数保留为仍然可以可靠计算的值，并忽略房屋、角度和其他与时间相关的结论。对于 Saju 来说，生物性别仅用于确定传统的 Daeun 方向。

西方和吠陀图表使用瑞士星历表天文数据； Saju 遵循韩国明里原则。 TriAstra 专为个人出生读数而设计，而不是每日预测或关系匹配。结果仅供思考和娱乐，并非医疗、法律、财务或其他专业建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6985e37c6b5881919f369288.productIntro: 想知道今天明星们怎么说吗？这个应用程序可以让您轻松阅读您的星座并了解每个星座。选择您的星座并在几秒钟内查看您的每日星座运势。您还可以探索有关所有十二个星座的有趣事实、简单指南和有用信息。一切都用清晰、简单的文字写成，因此任何人都可以享受阅读的乐趣。
plugin_asdk_app_6985e37c6b5881919f369288.productIntroEn: Want to know what the stars say today? This app makes it easy to read your horoscope and learn about every star sign. Pick your zodiac sign and see your daily horoscope in seconds. You can also explore fun facts, simple guides, and helpful information about all twelve zodiac signs. plugin_asdk_app_6985e37c6b5881919f369288.longDescription:
Want to know what the stars say today? This app makes it easy to read your horoscope and learn about every star sign. Pick your zodiac sign and see your daily horoscope in seconds. You can also explore fun facts, simple guides, and helpful information about all twelve zodiac signs. Everything is written in clear, easy words so anyone can enjoy reading it.

Whether you read your horoscope every day or you are just curious about astrology, this app gives you a quick and friendly way to explore. Read about your own sign or learn about your family and friends. Discover what makes every zodiac sign special, what each sign is known for, and how the signs are different from one another.

Every horoscope is easy to find. Just choose your sign and start reading. You do not need to search through long pages or confusing menus. The information is simple, organized, and easy to understand.

The app includes all twelve zodiac signs:

Aries

Taurus

Gemini

Cancer

Leo

Virgo

Libra

Scorpio

Sagittarius

Capricorn

Aquarius

Pisces

For every sign, you can learn about common personality traits, strengths, challenges, symbols, elements, and other interesting facts. If you have ever wondered why people talk about fire signs, earth signs, air signs, or water signs, you can find simple explanations here.

You can also discover the dates for every zodiac sign. If you are not sure which sign belongs to a birthday, the app makes it easy to check. It is a handy guide whenever you want to learn more about astrology or help someone else find their sign.

Daily horoscopes are quick to read. They are made for people who want a fast look at what the day may bring. Read your own horoscope in the morning, during the day, or whenever you want a little inspiration. You can also compare horoscopes with friends and family just for fun.

The app is designed to be simple and easy to use. Pages are clear. Navigation is easy. Information is organized so you can quickly find what you want. Whether you are new to astrology or have been reading horoscopes for years, you can enjoy exploring everything in one place.

If you are learning about zodiac signs for the first time, this app is a great place to begin. You do not need to know anything before you start. Each topic is explained in plain language without making things difficult. You can read a little or a lot, depending on what interests you.

If you already enjoy astrology, the app gives you a convenient way to check your horoscope and refresh your knowledge about every sign. It is useful as a quick reference whenever you want to remember dates, traits, elements, or symbols.

People use horoscopes in many different ways. Some read them every morning. Some enjoy talking about zodiac signs with friends. Others simply like learning about different personalities. No matter why you are interested, this app gives you one easy place to explore.

Features include:

• Daily horoscopes for every zodiac sign.
• Information about all twelve star signs.
• Zodiac sign dates.
• Personality traits.
• Strengths and challenges.
• Elements and symbols.
• Simple, easy-to-read explanations.
• Fast navigation.
• Clean layout.
• Great for beginners and astrology fans alike.

Whether you call them horoscopes, zodiac signs, or star signs, this app brings them together in one simple guide. Read today’s horoscope, explore every zodiac sign, learn something new, and enjoy discovering the world of astrology one sign at a time.

plugin_asdk_app_695c995d2b308191844e041c.longDescription:
12andus Astrology delivers professional-grade astrological insights powered by precise calculations and personalized charts analysis.

What You Can Explore

Personality & Psychological Insights
Discover your strengths, challenges, emotional patterns, and inner motivations based on your unique birth chart. Understand how you think, love, work, and
make decisions through the lens of your planetary placements.

Timing Guidance & Forecasts
Receive personalized transit forecasts for up to one year ahead, revealing upcoming periods of growth, change, opportunity, or challenge. See when
key planetary influences begin and end.

Relationship Compatibility
Explore the dynamics between you and anyone else through synastry analysis (how your charts interact) and composite charts (the unique energy your
relationship creates together). For romantic relationships, understand the chemistry of attraction, emotional compatibility, communication styles, intimacy patterns, and long-term potential. The same depth of analysis applies to any relationship — family bonds, friendships, business partnerships, or professional collaborations. See where you naturally harmonize, where friction may arise, and how to navigate differences with greater awareness.

Relationship Timing
Go beyond static compatibility — see how transiting planets activate your composite chart, revealing the best times for important relationship milestones,
conversations, or decisions.

Key Features
- Private Birth Data Storage — Securely save up to 50 birth charts under your account for instant access to readings without re-entering data
- Birth Charts — Complete natal analysis including planets, houses, aspects, and retrograde positions
- Transit Charts — Forecasts from 1 day to 365 days showing active planetary influences
- Relationship Charts — Synastry and composite analysis between any two saved people
- Relationship Forecasts — Transits to composite charts revealing relationship timing

Unmatched Precision
12andus calculations consider the exact planetary positions based on your specific birth date, time, and place. When birth time is unknown, the system adapts intelligently, providing insights without house-dependent data.

Holistic Readings
Unlike fragmented interpretations that list placements one by one, 12andus synthesizes your chart holistically — weaving together planetary positions, aspects, and houses into a unified narrative that reflects how these energies actually work together in your life.

关键的行星影响开始和结束。

关系兼容性

整体阅读

plugin_asdk_app_69446e62b0448191925a9c33.originalDescription: Find and tour homes for sale
plugin_asdk_app_69446e62b0448191925a9c33.productIntro: Redfin 让您通过对话而不是复杂的过滤器进行搜索，从而更轻松地找到待售房屋。
plugin_asdk_app_69446e62b0448191925a9c33.productIntroEn: Redfin makes it easier to find homes for sale by letting you search through conversation, not complex filters.
plugin_asdk_app_69446e62b0448191925a9c33.longDescription:
Redfin makes it easier to find homes for sale by letting you search through conversation, not complex filters.

With Redfin, you can describe what you’re looking for in your own words and refine your search naturally through follow-up questions. Whether you care most about price, location, home style, or specific features, the experience helps surface homes that better match what you mean, not just what you type.
You can browse photos, maps, and up-to-date property details, then schedule a tour with ease when you’re ready to take the next step.

You can ask questions like:
 • Show me remodeled homes in the East Bay under $900,000
 • Find single-family homes near parks with high ceilings within 40 minutes of Austin
 • Show me homes in Oceanside under $800k
plugin_asdk_app_69446e62b0448191925a9c33.longDescriptionZh:
Redfin 让您通过对话而不是复杂的过滤器进行搜索，从而更轻松地找到待售房屋。

借助 Redfin，您可以用自己的话描述您要查找的内容，并通过后续问题自然地完善您的搜索。无论您最关心的是价格、位置、家居风格还是特定功能，这种体验都可以帮助您显示更符合您的意思的房屋，而不仅仅是您输入的内容。
您可以浏览照片、地图和最新的房产详细信息，然后在准备好采取下一步行动时轻松安排游览。

您可以提出以下问题：
 • 向我展示东湾 900,000 美元以下的改建房屋
 • 查找距奥斯汀 40 分钟路程内公园附近高天花板的单户住宅
 • 显示 80 万美元以下的欧申赛德 (Oceanside) 房屋
defaultPrompts: Show me 3 bedroom homes in Seattle with a modern kitchen

Hepsiemlak brings hundreds of thousands of for-sale and rental listings — including apartments, detached houses, commercial properties, and land — from Türkiye’s leading real estate platform right to your fingertips.
plugin_asdk_app_6981e59048848191be52e8fa.developerName: Glokal Dijital Hizmetler Pazarlama ve Ticaret A.Ş.
plugin_asdk_app_6981e59048848191be52e8fa.longDescription:
Search real estate listings from all across Türkiye directly through ChatGPT. Hepsiemlak brings hundreds of thousands of for-sale and rental listings — including apartments, detached houses, commercial properties, and land — from Türkiye’s leading real estate platform right to your fingertips.

Simply type **@hepsiemlak** and describe what you’re looking for in your everyday language: a 2+1 rental apartment in Beşiktaş, a sea-view villa in Bodrum, or a workplace within a specific budget. The app presents listings that match your search criteria on an interactive map with pins, along with a list displaying key details such as price, square meters, number of rooms, floor level, and building age.

You can tap on any listing to view photos and detailed information. When you find a property you like, click the “View All Features” button to continue on hepsiemlak.com or the Hepsiemlak mobile app and contact the advertiser directly.
plugin_asdk_app_6981e59048848191be52e8fa.longDescriptionZh:
直接通过 ChatGPT 搜索土耳其各地的房地产列表。 Hepsiemlak 将土耳其领先的房地产平台上的数十万个待售和租赁清单（包括公寓、独立屋、商业地产和土地）带到您的指尖。

只需输入 **@hepsiemlak** 并用日常语言描述您正在寻找的东西：贝西克塔斯的 2+1 出租公寓、博德鲁姆的海景别墅或特定预算内的工作场所。该应用程序在带有图钉的交互式地图上显示与您的搜索条件相匹配的列表，以及显示价格、平方米、房间数量、楼层和建筑年龄等关键详细信息的列表。

您可以点击任何列表来查看照片和详细信息。当您找到您喜欢的房产时，请点击“查看所有功能”按钮继续访问 hepsiemlak.com 或 Hepsiemlak 移动应用程序并直接联系广告商。

plugin_asdk_app_6a29247dd3fc8191aa56c836.productIntro: Engel & Völkers 是优质住宅和商业房地产的全球平台，将定制的房产搜索直接带入您的 ChatGPT 对话中。使用自然语言探索独特的公寓、历史悠久的别墅和优质投资物业，没有繁琐的表格，只有无缝的对话。
plugin_asdk_app_6a29247dd3fc8191aa56c836.productIntroEn: Engel & Völkers, the global platform for premium residential and commercial real estate, brings bespoke property search directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Discover exclusive apartments, historic villas, and prime investment properties using natural language, no tedious forms, just seamless conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a29247dd3fc8191aa56c836.longDescription:
Engel & Völkers, the global platform for premium residential and commercial real estate, brings bespoke property search directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Discover exclusive apartments, historic villas, and prime investment properties using natural language, no tedious forms, just seamless conversation.

Explore high-end listings with stunning imagery, interactive maps, and detailed pricing right in the chat. View your curated results as a sleek carousel or see properties pinned on a map to evaluate premium neighborhoods at a glance.

Try asking things like:
- Show me 3-bedroom apartments for rent in Berlin
- Find me houses to buy in Paris with a garden
- I'm looking for a penthouse with a sea view in Barcelona
- Show me premium houses in Rome

From price ranges and room counts to specific premium features and elite neighborhoods, Engel & Völkers makes discovering exceptional properties simple, all through first-class, natural conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a29247dd3fc8191aa56c836.longDescriptionZh:
Engel & Völkers 是优质住宅和商业房地产的全球平台，将定制的房产搜索直接带入您的 ChatGPT 对话中。使用自然语言探索独特的公寓、历史悠久的别墅和优质投资物业，没有繁琐的表格，只有无缝的对话。

直接在聊天中探索具有令人惊叹的图像、交互式地图和详细定价的高端列表。以时尚的轮播方式查看您策划的结果，或者查看固定在地图上的房产，以便一目了然地评估优质社区。

尝试询问以下问题：
- 显示在柏林出租的三卧室公寓
- 为我寻找在巴黎购买带花园的房子
- 我正在巴塞罗那寻找海景顶层公寓
- 显示罗马的优质房屋

从价格范围和房间数量到特定的高级功能和精英社区，Engel & Völkers 让发现非凡房产变得简单，一切都通过一流、自然的对话。

plugin_asdk_app_69d48d1113e88191954bf235.name: Workopia
plugin_asdk_app_69d48d1113e88191954bf235.productIntro: Workopia AI 将完整的求职体验带入 ChatGPT - 无需额外的选项卡，无需单独注册。
plugin_asdk_app_69d48d1113e88191954bf235.productIntroEn: Workopia AI brings the full job search experience into ChatGPT — no extra tabs, no separate sign-ups.
plugin_asdk_app_69d48d1113e88191954bf235.longDescription:
Workopia AI brings the full job search experience into ChatGPT — no extra tabs, no separate sign-ups.

Key Highlights

• Employer-direct, real-time jobs
Listings are pulled live from company career pages and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), so you see roles as soon as they’re posted — not recycled from third-party job boards.

• Must-have vs. nice-to-have, at a glance
Each role is pre-tagged to help you scan quickly: required skills are clearly highlighted, while additional “nice-to-have” criteria are separated out.

• Tailor your resume inline
Open any job and click *Tailor* to instantly adapt your resume. A live widget highlights missing skills and lets you add supporting evidence in real time. Export an ATS-friendly PDF in one click.

• Cover letter + apply
Generate a role-specific cover letter from the same chat, download it as a PDF, and apply directly via the employer’s official posting.

Search → Read → Tailor → Cover Letter → Apply
All in one conversation, end to end.
plugin_asdk_app_69d48d1113e88191954bf235.longDescriptionZh:
Workopia AI 将完整的求职体验带入 ChatGPT - 无需额外的选项卡，无需单独注册。

主要亮点

• 雇主直接的实时工作
列表是从公司职业页面和申请人跟踪系统 (ATS) 中实时提取的，因此您一发布就可以看到职位，而不是从第三方招聘委员会回收。

• 必备与锦上添花一目了然
每个角色都经过预先标记，以帮助您快速浏览：明确突出显示所需技能，同时分离出额外的“必备”标准。

• 内联定制您的简历
打开任何工作并单击“定制”即可立即调整您的简历。实时小部件会突出显示缺失的技能，并让您实时添加支持证据。一键导出 ATS 友好的 PDF。

• 求职信+申请
从同一次聊天中生成针对特定职位的求职信，将其下载为 PDF，然后直接通过雇主的官方帖子进行申请。

搜索→阅读→定制→求职信→申请
一切都在一次对话中，端到端。

Write what you need, such as: "I want to rent a two-bedroom apartment in Pinheiros for up to R$5,000" and instantly receive a personalized selection of properties.
plugin_asdk_app_6967a44d66348191b91c9bf4.longDescription:
Thousands of houses and apartments for rent and sale, and one of them could be yours.
With the QuintoAndar ChatGPT app, you have another simple way to find what you are looking for.
Write what you need, such as: "I want to rent a two-bedroom apartment in Pinheiros for up to R$5,000" and instantly receive a personalized selection of properties. Choose the ones that caught your attention the most and click on "View property" to access all the details on the QuintoAndar platform, schedule a visit, and find the place that best suits you.
And if you are an owner, the process is also fast and simple: access the QuintoAndar app to list your property easily and reach thousands of interested people.

plugin_asdk_app_69adad9bda08819187d81b71.name: Pantry Persona
plugin_asdk_app_69adad9bda08819187d81b71.productIntro: 您最喜欢的厨房管理应用程序所做的一切以及更多功能都在 ChatGPT 中。
plugin_asdk_app_69adad9bda08819187d81b71.productIntroEn: Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69adad9bda08819187d81b71.longDescription:
Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside ChatGPT.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.
plugin_asdk_app_69adad9bda08819187d81b71.longDescriptionZh:
您最喜欢的厨房管理应用程序所做的一切以及更多功能都在 ChatGPT 中。

Pantry Persona 会记住您冰箱里的东西、您的家人可以吃什么、不能吃什么以及您喜欢哪些品牌。它存储您的食谱，计划您的膳食，建立您的购物清单，并跟踪这一切背后的营养成分，然后在您一周烹饪和购物时保持所有内容同步

**食谱** — 从网站、烹饪视频或社交帖子中保存食谱，或者只是在对话中创建食谱。按食材、美食或您现在可以用现有材料制作的食物进行搜索，并将您最喜欢的食物分组到集合中。

**膳食计划** — 一次性生成一整周的膳食，或逐日制定。计划会自动尊重您家庭的食物偏好和饮食规则，并提供每餐营养，以便您了解一周的情况。

**购物清单** — 按商店组织的可视化交互式清单。一键检查项目。从你的膳食计划中索要一份购物清单，它会跳过你食品储藏室里已有的任何东西。当您准备购买时，将其发送到 Instacart。

**烹饪模式** — 开始烹饪菜谱并获得分步指导。完成后，配料将从您的食品储藏室中扣除，并跟踪剩余的食品和过期日期。

**营养** — 查看每份食谱和膳食的卡路里和宏量，为每个人设定自己的每日目标，并检查今天或本周的进展情况。记录你实际吃了什么，甚至是外出就餐，它都会会计入你的总数。

**您的个性化厨房** — 家庭档案存储每个家庭成员的食物偏好、饮食规则、喜爱的品牌和营养目标。每个建议、计划和搜索都会经过它们的过滤，因此您不必重复自己。邀请其他家庭成员，每个人都可以实时使用同一个食品储藏室、食谱和购物清单。

还可以跟踪食品储藏室的有效期，预测您的主食何时会耗尽，了解您购买的品牌和价格，并将杂货收据转化为最新的库存和清晰的支出情况。

Make a meal plan for today and tomorrow.
What is on my shopping list?
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我保存的食谱。
制定今天和明天的膳食计划。
我的购物清单上有什么？

plugin_asdk_app_6a2063ffb220819187436517.name: Nash Agent
plugin_asdk_app_6a2063ffb220819187436517.description: 人工智能驱动的购物代理
plugin_asdk_app_6a2063ffb220819187436517.productIntro: Pier39 实现了一种新的购物体验：代理商对代理商的商务。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2063ffb220819187436517.productIntroEn: Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2063ffb220819187436517.longDescription:
Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

The app can:

• Search across participating stores for products matching user intent
• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions
• Compare offers across multiple merchants
• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2063ffb220819187436517.longDescriptionZh:
Pier39 实现了一种新的购物体验：代理商对代理商的商务。

用户可以描述他们想要的东西和预算，而不是手动浏览商店并与卖家谈判。 Pier39 发现参与 negotiate.v1 的商家，找到匹配的产品，与商家 AI 销售代理展开谈判，并代表用户争取最佳交易。

该应用程序可以：

• 在参与商店中搜索符合用户意图的产品
• 自动发现产品目录和定价
• 协商折扣、捆绑、运输、保修和其他优惠
• 比较多个商家的报价
• 总结谈判成果和节省机会
• 帮助用户做出更明智的购买决策

Pier39 基于 negotiate.v1 协议构建，这是一种开放标准，允许 AI 购物代理和 AI 商家代理无需事先集成或协调即可进行协商。

plugin_asdk_app_6a451d5c44f881919c7b0c75.productIntro: 不离开聊天室就可以打鼓。点击鼓组，制作节拍，然后让 ChatGPT 听您演奏的内容。它可以告诉您哪些方面进展顺利，哪些地方准时停留，哪些地方匆忙或放慢了速度，以及改进的简单方法。您不需要特殊的装备或音乐技能即可开始。打开应用程序、玩游戏并在同一对话中获取反馈。
plugin_asdk_app_6a451d5c44f881919c7b0c75.productIntroEn: Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a451d5c44f881919c7b0c75.longDescription:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.
plugin_asdk_app_6a451d5c44f881919c7b0c75.longDescriptionZh:
不离开聊天室就可以打鼓。点击鼓组，制作节拍，然后让 ChatGPT 听您演奏的内容。它可以告诉您哪些方面进展顺利，哪些地方准时停留，哪些地方匆忙或放慢了速度，以及改进的简单方法。您不需要特殊的装备或音乐技能即可开始。打开应用程序、玩游戏并在同一对话中获取反馈。

鼓组就位于 ChatGPT 内，因此在开始之前无需学习任何额外内容。当你玩的时候，每一次击球都会被捕捉到。 ChatGPT 可以查看您的节奏、时间、速度和模式，而不是根据描述进行猜测。这意味着建议是基于您实际玩过的内容，而不是您试图解释的内容。您可以在每次拍摄后提出问题，重试，看看您的演奏如何随着时间的推移而变化。

这使得练习变得简单。播放慢节奏的摇滚乐。尝试快速填充。创造你自己的节奏。复制您在歌曲中听到的节奏。然后询问 ChatGPT 它注意到了什么。它可以指出稳定的部分、错过的节拍、不均匀的间距以及双手可以更好地配合的地方。如果某件事听起来不错，它可以解释原因。如果感觉某件事很难，可以将问题分解为小步骤。

初学者可以用它来学习基本节拍并建立信心。更有经验的鼓手可以测试想法，探索不同的节奏，或检查他们的节奏是否一致。教师可以用它来帮助学生理解练习课程。父母可以为孩子提供一种有趣的方式来探索音乐，而无需在家中配备全套架子鼓。任何对节奏感兴趣的人都可以加入并开始演奏。

因为一切都发生在一次对话中，所以练习感觉很自然。您玩游戏，ChatGPT 聆听，提出问题，然后立即得到答案。无需在不同的应用程序之间切换、上传录音或解释发生了什么。性能已经可供 ChatGPT 审核。这样可以让您专注于制作音乐而不是管理文件。

您也可以要求不同类型的反馈。想要快速得分吗？求一份。想要详细的分解吗？而是要求这个。想要孩子能够轻松遵循的提示吗？ ChatGPT 可以做到这一点。想要更像鼓老师的建议吗？它可以改变其风格以符合您的目标。你控制对话。
该应用程序也非常适合应对小挑战。看看你能否保持稳定的节拍一分钟。尝试演奏得更轻或更响。练习只用一只手。建立一个简单的律动，慢慢让它变得更有趣。每次尝试后，ChatGPT 都可以解释发生了什么变化并建议下一个挑战。小小的胜利会累积起来，每一个新的节奏都会给你一些值得学习的东西。

这在 ChatGPT 中创造了一种不同的音乐体验。不只是谈论打鼓，你实际上可以打鼓。您收到的不是一般建议，而是与您自己的表现相关的反馈。所有东西都集中在一处，而不是停下来在工具之间移动。结果是一种有趣的练习、学习、实验和改进的方式。无论您从未拿过棍子，已经每周都玩，或者只是想敲出几分钟有趣的节拍，该应用程序会将对话变成一个互动练习空间，每次敲击都可以成为学习的机会。

plugin_asdk_app_69c57a96868c8191a2974977.longDescription:
Search and explore real estate across India with Square Yards.
                                                                                                    
  Square Yards gives you conversational access to one of India's largest property databases. Search
  new construction projects, rental apartments, and resale properties across major cities, all     
  through natural conversation.                                                                     
                                                                                                    
  Find new projects: Browse new-construction developments with filters for city, budget, unit type,
  developer, and project status. Dive into any project to see pricing, floor plans, amenities, and
  unit configurations.                                                                              
                  
  Search rentals: Explore rental listings filtered by city, rent range, BHK type, furnishing       
  status, and amenities. Get full details on any listing including images and pricing.
                                                                                                    
  Browse resale properties: Discover resale and second-hand listings with filters for city, price  
  range, unit type, and amenities. View complete property details for any listing that catches your
  eye.                                                                                              
                  
  Results appear as interactive property cards with images, pricing, and direct links to      
  Square Yards. Whether you're buying your first home, searching for a rental, or exploring
  investment opportunities, Square Yards helps you make informed property decisions through          
  conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_69f34c257e348191837391ad.name: Lifestyle Helper
plugin_asdk_app_69f34c257e348191837391ad.description: 值得信赖的日常生活提示
plugin_asdk_app_69f34c257e348191837391ad.productIntro: Lifestyle Helper 通过添加来自可信专家材料的可靠、最新、有来源支持的上下文，改进了 ChatGPT 对日常生活问题的回答。
plugin_asdk_app_69f34c257e348191837391ad.productIntroEn: Lifestyle Helper improves ChatGPT answers to everyday life questions by adding reliable, up-to-date, source-backed context from trusted expert materials.
plugin_asdk_app_69f34c257e348191837391ad.longDescription:
Lifestyle Helper improves ChatGPT answers to everyday life questions by adding reliable, up-to-date, source-backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about cooking, travel, entertainment, education, or psychology, the app enriches responses with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally without external references.

Lifestyle Helper does not collect personal data and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based only on the user’s intentions.
plugin_asdk_app_69f34c257e348191837391ad.longDescriptionZh:
Lifestyle Helper 通过添加来自可信专家材料的可靠、最新、有来源支持的上下文，改进了 ChatGPT 对日常生活问题的回答。

当用户询问烹饪、旅行、娱乐、教育或心理学时，该应用程序会通过相关示例和对现实世界见解的参考来丰富回答。仅当上下文明显提高实用性时才添加上下文。如果没有找到相关来源，ChatGPT 会正常响应，无需外部参考。

生活帮手不收集个人数据，也不提供专业的法律或财务建议。任何外部服务都是仅根据用户的意图推荐的。
defaultPrompts: What are the best places for hiking ?
defaultPromptsZh: 哪些地方最适合徒步旅行？

plugin_asdk_app_6a222b08034c8191971de848.productIntro: Unni 将亚洲最大的医疗手术平台之一引入 ChatGPT。用您自己的话询问，并在丰富的卡片中一目了然地查看 Unni 应用程序中提供的相同程序和事件信息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a222b08034c8191971de848.productIntroEn: Unni brings one of Asia's largest medical procedure platforms into ChatGPT. Ask in your own words and see the same procedure and event information available in the Unni app at a glance in rich cards.
plugin_asdk_app_6a222b08034c8191971de848.longDescription:
Unni brings one of Asia's largest medical procedure platforms into ChatGPT. Ask in your own words and see the same procedure and event information available in the Unni app at a glance in rich cards.

What you can search:
• Procedure knowledge: expert-written guides on procedures, side effects, recovery, and procedure comparisons.
• Community: real user experiences and doctor-answered Q&A from the Unni community.
• Events: current pricing and promotions across thousands of clinics, filterable by procedure, location, consultation language, and price.

Unni searches from information pools matched to your country and language, so you can see procedure information and events that are actually available to you.

Unni provides reference information only and is not a medical recommendation. Always consult a licensed medical professional before making procedure decisions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a222b08034c8191971de848.longDescriptionZh:
Unni 将亚洲最大的医疗手术平台之一引入 ChatGPT。用您自己的话询问，并在丰富的卡片中一目了然地查看 Unni 应用程序中提供的相同程序和事件信息。

您可以搜索什么：
• 手术知识：专家编写的关于手术、副作用、恢复和手术比较的指南。
• 社区：来自Unni 社区的真实用户体验和医生解答的问答。
• 活动：数千家诊所的当前定价和促销活动，可按程序、地点、咨询语言和价格进行过滤。

Unni 从与您所在国家/地区和语言相匹配的信息库中进行搜索，以便您可以查看实际可用的程序信息和活动。

Unni仅提供参考信息，并非医疗建议。在做出手术决定之前，请务必咨询有执照的医疗专业人员。

plugin_asdk_app_69ef477faf648191be687232.longDescription:
BuyWise is a shopping assistant for comparing physical consumer products in ChatGPT. Tell BuyWise what you are looking for, including your budget, use case, preferred features, and constraints, and it helps compare relevant products from supported merchants.
BuyWise can help users:
• Search for products that match a shopping need or budget.
• Compare prices, availability, product details, and key purchase considerations across supported merchants.
• Summarize useful review signals and product tradeoffs to support a more informed purchase decision.
• Recommend suitable options for specific scenarios, such as gifts, home office setups, travel accessories, or consumer tech purchases.
• Direct users to external merchant pages to complete purchases outside ChatGPT.
BuyWise does not process payments inside ChatGPT, does not sell digital goods, and does not replace the merchant’s checkout, return, warranty, or support policies.

plugin_asdk_app_6963606dd8e081919e40c880.longDescription:
"Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check" helps you review contracts and spot common red flags before signing. Get a clear, card-based overview with risk flags and concise notes on key clauses. Click any card to ask ChatGPT for a deeper explanation.

How it works:
The app contains a checklist of common issues for different contract types:
- Lease
- Employment
- Freelance
- General agreements
The app instructs ChatGPT to assess your agreement through the checklist tailored to your contract type. Results of the review are presented as clickable "Ok" / "Warning" / "High-Risk" cards.

Disclaimers:
- Use this app as an extra set of eyes - not a replacement for legal advice.
- Get a lawyer’s review for high-value, high-risk, or unfamiliar terms.
- Read the full contract and make sure you understand it before signing.

Not legal advice. The developer of "Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check" is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. No attorney-client relationship is created. Outputs are AI-generated and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated. Use it for informational purposes only and consult a qualified attorney for legal advice before signing. Do not use this app for criminal law matters, immigration matters, or family law disputes.
plugin_asdk_app_6963606dd8e081919e40c880.longDescriptionZh:
“Safe2Sign：合同风险检查”可帮助您在签署前审查合同并发现常见的危险信号。获得清晰的、基于卡片的概述，包括风险标记和关键条款的简明注释。单击任意卡片即可向 ChatGPT 询问更深入的解释。

工作原理：
该应用程序包含不同合同类型的常见问题清单：
- 租赁
- 就业
- 自由职业者
- 一般协议
该应用程序指示 ChatGPT 通过根据您的合同类型定制的清单来评估您的协议。审核结果显示为可点击的“好”/“警告”/“高风险”卡。

免责声明：
- 使用此应用程序作为额外的眼睛 - 不能替代法律建议。
- 获得律师对高价值、高风险或不熟悉的术语的审查。
- 在签署之前阅读完整的合同并确保您理解它。

不是法律建议。 “Safe2Sign：合同风险检查”的开发商不是律师事务所，不提供法律建议。不会建立律师与委托人的关系。输出是人工智能生成的，可能不准确、不完整或过时。仅供参考，并在签字前咨询合格的律师以获得法律建议。请勿将此应用程序用于刑法事务、移民事务或家庭法纠纷。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3ee120d2b48191a8feee9d.longDescription:
Ask ChatGPT for a recipe, then actually cook it: Dillr turns it into a step-by-step cook mode with built-in timers and the ingredients one tap away. 

When you find a keeper, save it. Dillr remembers your recipes and your preferences, so every suggestion is relevant to you.

Plan your week in one conversation: real recipes for every meal and a shopping list organized the way you shop, ready to tick off when you're at the store.

Everything you save lives in Dillr, accessible by ChatGPT and in the app when you want it.

当你找到守门员时，保存它。 Dillr 会记住您的食谱和偏好，因此每条建议都与您相关。

通过一次对话即可计划您的一周：每顿饭的真正食谱和按您购物方式组织的购物清单，以便您在商店时可以勾选。

您在 Dillr 中拯救生命的一切，都可以通过 ChatGPT 访问，并在需要时在应用程序中访问。

Whether you're wondering what to make with a bunch of lemons or planning healthy dinners for the whole week, Love & Lemons makes it effortless and delicious.

plugin_asdk_app_69bda0ecbc0881919d6fddb8.longDescription:
The Loft app helps you find the ideal property in a simple, fast, and smart way.
Here, you can search for properties available for purchase or rent, compare options, understand market prices, and make decisions with greater confidence.

In addition to search, the app offers insights that make your choice easier, such as value estimates, property features, and comparisons across different regions.
Everything is designed for those who want to avoid hassle and save time when choosing a place to live or invest.

Whether you’re looking for your next home or a great investment opportunity, Loft provides clear information and technology to support your decision.
plugin_asdk_app_69bda0ecbc0881919d6fddb8.longDescriptionZh:

在这里，您可以搜索可供购买或出租的房产、比较选项、了解市场价格并更有信心地做出决策。

除了搜索之外，该应用程序还提供使您的选择更容易的见解，例如价值估算、房产特征以及不同地区的比较。
一切都是为那些在选择居住或投资地点时想要避免麻烦并节省时间的人而设计的。

无论您是在寻找下一个家还是绝佳的投资机会，Loft 都能提供清晰的信息和技术来支持您的决定。

plugin_asdk_app_69f52db368a881919443d6b1.description: 通过跟踪追踪任何包裹
plugin_asdk_app_69f52db368a881919443d6b1.productIntro: Shipal 通过 17Track 服务在全球数百家承运商中通过追踪号码查找任何包裹的实时状态。该小部件呈现自动检测到的承运商、规范的货件状态（已交付、在途、待交付、异常等）、带有城市级清理位置的最新跟踪事件、运输天数以及承运商的预计交付窗口。下面显示了按时间顺序排列的事件时间表。只读、无身份验证、无 PII 集合。错误返回小部件作为目标警报显示的键入代码。
plugin_asdk_app_69f52db368a881919443d6b1.productIntroEn: Shipal looks up the live status of any parcel by tracking number, across hundreds of carriers worldwide via the 17Track service. The widget renders the auto-detected carrier, canonical shipment status (Delivered, In Transit, Out for Delivery, Exception, etc.), the most recent tracking event with a city-level scrubbed location, days in transit, and the carrier's estimated delivery window.
plugin_asdk_app_69f52db368a881919443d6b1.longDescription: Shipal looks up the live status of any parcel by tracking number, across hundreds of carriers worldwide via the 17Track service. The widget renders the auto-detected carrier, canonical shipment status   (Delivered, In Transit, Out for Delivery, Exception, etc.), the most recent tracking event with a city-level scrubbed location, days in transit, and the carrier's estimated delivery window. A chronological event timeline is shown beneath. Read-only, no auth, no PII collection. Errors return typed codes that the widget surfaces as targeted alerts.

Cette application vous aide à trouver rapidement le véhicule qui correspond à vos besoins parmi les annonces disponibles sur La Centrale.

Décrivez simplement le type de véhicule que vous recherchez : marque, modèle, budget, carburant, kilométrage ou encore localisation. L’assistant analysera votre demande et vous proposera des véhicules adaptés.

plugin_asdk_app_69a751a2cb848191818f5ba7.productIntro: Bandsintown 提供实时音乐会和巡演信息，因此您可以按艺术家、地点或日期轻松查找现场音乐。
plugin_asdk_app_69a751a2cb848191818f5ba7.productIntroEn: Bandsintown provides real-time concert and tour information so you can easily find live music by artist, location, or date.
plugin_asdk_app_69a751a2cb848191818f5ba7.longDescription:
Bandsintown provides real-time concert and tour information so you can easily find live music by artist, location, or date.

Use Bandsintown to:
Find concerts and live music near you tonight, this weekend, or on any date
Check if your favorite artists are touring and where they’re playing
Find shows by location, venue, or genre
Get tour dates and event details, including links to tickets from official ticket sellers

Bandsintown covers concerts and live music worldwide, so you can plan with confidence.

Try asking:
“What concerts are in [city] this weekend?”
“Is [artist name] on tour right now?”
“Show me music venues in [city]”
“What’s playing at [venue name] tonight?”

Whether you’re looking for a last-minute show or planning ahead for a major tour, Bandsintown helps you keep track of upcoming live music.
plugin_asdk_app_69a751a2cb848191818f5ba7.longDescriptionZh:
Bandsintown 提供实时音乐会和巡演信息，因此您可以按艺术家、地点或日期轻松查找现场音乐。

使用 Bandsintown 可以：
今晚、本周末或任何日期查找您附近的音乐会和现场音乐
检查您最喜欢的艺术家是否正在巡演以及他们在哪里演出
按地点、地点或类型查找节目
获取旅游日期和活动详细信息，包括官方售票员提供的门票链接

Bandsintown 涵盖世界各地的音乐会和现场音乐，因此您可以放心地计划。

尝试询问：
“这个周末[城市]有哪些音乐会？”
“[艺术家姓名]现在正在巡演吗？”
“显示 [城市] 的音乐场所”
“今晚[场地名称]有什么演出？”

无论您是在寻找最后一刻的演出还是提前计划大型巡演，Bandsintown 都可以帮助您跟踪即将到来的现场音乐。

plugin_asdk_app_69eea2e800688191bf8532a4.longDescription:
Lalso turns your event invitations into beautiful, mobile-friendly online experiences with built-in RSVP tracking. Create digital invitations for weddings, birthdays, baby showers, engagements, anniversaries, graduations, and corporate events in just a few minutes. 

Pick from ready-made templates, then customize colors, photos, background music, fonts, and text to match your event style. Share one short link with your guests; they confirm attendance, leave a message, view event details, and add the date to their calendar — no app download required. 

Manage everything from a real-time dashboard with live guest counts, plus-ones, dietary notes, and exportable guest lists. Available in 12 languages and built to work on any device, so planning your next event stays simple, organized, and stress-free
plugin_asdk_app_69eea2e800688191bf8532a4.longDescriptionZh:

从现成的模板中进行选择，然后自定义颜色、照片、背景音乐、字体和文本以匹配您的活动风格。与您的客人分享一个短链接；他们确认出席、留言、查看活动详细信息，并将日期添加到日历中 - 无需下载应用程序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a44f48e3be081918cef8da5.developerName: BAYUT WEB ALSAUDIAH FOR TECHNOLOGY COMMUNICATION SPC
plugin_asdk_app_6a44f48e3be081918cef8da5.longDescription:
Bayut KSA helps users explore residential, commercial, and short-term real estate listings across Saudi Arabia directly in ChatGPT.

Use Bayut KSA when you want to search for properties to buy, lease annually, or rent daily for short stays in cities such as Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Makkah, Madinah, and other locations across the Kingdom. The app can help users discover apartments, villas, houses, furnished units, land, offices, and other available property types based on their preferences.

plugin_asdk_app_69fcadaf68148191a21542f4.productIntroEn: Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.
plugin_asdk_app_69fcadaf68148191a21542f4.longDescription:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.
plugin_asdk_app_69fcadaf68148191a21542f4.longDescriptionZh:
Deglaze 将您的食谱库带入 ChatGPT，将其变成一个烹饪助手，从您和您的家人实际烹饪的内容开始。它连接您的 Deglaze 帐户 - 保存的食谱（来自网站、社交媒体、食谱等）、膳食计划、购物清单、家庭食物偏好和烹饪历史 - 因此食谱建议反映您的真实口味和限制。

询问晚餐创意并从您自己的图书馆获取食谱，或者从 Deglaze 的发现数据库中拓展新食谱并将管理员保存到您的图书馆。以带有照片的菜谱卡形式浏览结果，点击查看完整菜谱，或者在对话中根据家庭最爱、您提到的配料或 ChatGPT 帮助开发的想法创建新菜谱。

然后将想法转化为行动：将食谱放在您的膳食计划中，将其成分添加到您的购物清单中，同时跳过您告诉它要省略的项目，并在购物时管理清单。 Deglaze 根据您的喜好和烹饪历史来避免过敏，倾向于您的家人喜欢的口味，并建议膳食，而无需重复最近的晚餐。

plugin_asdk_app_696a2c4321188191a92cb65f.longDescription:
Discover real estate listings across Türkiye directly through ChatGPT with a fast and intelligent search experience. Our app consolidates a comprehensive range of properties—from apartments and villas to land and commercial spaces—enabling you to efficiently identify the options that best match your requirements.

Type @Emlakjet and describe your needs in natural language: a three-bedroom apartment for sale in Kadıköy, or a sea-view villa in Çeşme or an investment plot under 2 million TL in Balıkesir. Our advanced search engine interprets your criteria and surfaces the most relevant listings, displaying essential details such as price, size, and location at a glance.

The map-based search feature allows you to explore listings visually, discover nearby opportunities through interactive pins, and gain a clearer understanding of each property's surroundings. Select any listing to view photos and detailed specifications. Once you find a property that meets your expectations, proceed to the full listing page to review all features and connect directly with the advertise

plugin_asdk_app_69c15630184081919f01076d.productIntro: HouseToSpot 是一款现代化的房产搜索应用程序，旨在让您寻找下一个家变得简单、直观且具有视觉吸引力。用户无需浏览无休止的列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索房地产，从而更容易一目了然地了解位置、社区和附近的便利设施。
plugin_asdk_app_69c15630184081919f01076d.productIntroEn: HouseToSpot is a modern property search app designed to make finding your next home simple, intuitive, and visually engaging. Instead of browsing endless lists, users can explore real estate directly on an interactive map, making it easier to understand locations, neighborhoods, and nearby amenities at a glance.
plugin_asdk_app_69c15630184081919f01076d.longDescription:
HouseToSpot is a modern property search app designed to make finding your next home simple, intuitive, and visually engaging. Instead of browsing endless lists, users can explore real estate directly on an interactive map, making it easier to understand locations, neighborhoods, and nearby amenities at a glance.

With HouseToSpot, you can search properties by city and instantly see available listings pinned on a dynamic map. Each property is easy to access, giving you quick insights into pricing, location, and key details without unnecessary complexity.

The app focuses on a clean, user-friendly experience, helping users:

Discover properties in their desired city
Navigate listings through an interactive map interface
Quickly compare locations and housing options
Save time by visualizing results instead of scrolling through static lists

Whether you’re looking to rent, buy, or simply explore the market, HouseToSpot provides a smarter, map-based approach to property discovery.
plugin_asdk_app_69c15630184081919f01076d.longDescriptionZh:
HouseToSpot 是一款现代化的房产搜索应用程序，旨在让您寻找下一个家变得简单、直观且具有视觉吸引力。用户无需浏览无休止的列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索房地产，从而更容易一目了然地了解位置、社区和附近的便利设施。

借助 HouseToSpot，您可以按城市搜索房产，并立即查看动态地图上固定的可用列表。每个房产都很容易访问，让您快速了解价格、位置和关键细节，而无需不必要的复杂性。

该应用程序专注于干净、用户友好的体验，帮助用户：

发现他们想要的城市的房产
通过交互式地图界面导航列表
快速比较位置和住房选择
通过可视化结果而不是滚动静态列表来节省时间

无论您是想租房、买房，还是只是探索市场，HouseToSpot 都能提供更智能、基于地图的房产发现方法。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1173f02cd081919f2912a4.name: Getir
plugin_asdk_app_6a1173f02cd081919f2912a4.productIntro: Getir 让您无需离开 ChatGPT 对话即可订购杂货。从一个自然的句子开始，比如“订购牛奶、面包和鸡蛋回家”。该应用程序连接到您的帐户，让您从保存的送货地址中进行选择，构建您的购物车，然后将您交给 Getir 移动应用程序来完成付款。每个步骤都直接在聊天中显示为一个小型互动卡。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1173f02cd081919f2912a4.productIntroEn: Getir lets you order groceries without leaving your ChatGPT conversation. Start with a natural sentence like "order milk, bread, and eggs to home." The app connects to your account, lets you pick from your saved delivery addresses, builds your cart, and hands you off to the Getir mobile app to complete payment. Each step appears as a small interactive card directly in the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1173f02cd081919f2912a4.longDescription:
Getir lets you order groceries without leaving your ChatGPT conversation. Start with a natural sentence like "order milk, bread, and eggs to home." The app connects to your account, lets you pick from your saved delivery addresses, builds your cart, and hands you off to the Getir mobile app to complete payment. Each step appears as a small interactive card directly in the chat.

You get two delivery options in one place. Getir handles on-demand convenience baskets delivered in minutes; GetirBüyük covers same-day large-basket delivery for weekly shopping with a broader assortment. You can switch between them inside the conversation depending on what you need.

You can search products in natural language and see live price and stock, choose from saved addresses or add a new one, and add, remove, or bulk-update items in your cart. Asking something like "plan a shopping list for the weekend" generates a multi-item list you can review and confirm. Featured deals and recommendations are available in the same flow. When you are ready to order, payment is completed in the Getir app or in your web cart.

Your account and payment data stay with Getir. Only the information needed to fulfill the order is shared with ChatGPT, and payment data is never sent to ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1173f02cd081919f2912a4.longDescriptionZh:
Getir 让您无需离开 ChatGPT 对话即可订购杂货。从一个自然的句子开始，比如“订购牛奶、面包和鸡蛋回家”。该应用程序连接到您的帐户，让您从保存的送货地址中进行选择，构建您的购物车，然后将您交给 Getir 移动应用程序来完成付款。每个步骤都直接在聊天中显示为一个小型互动卡。

您可以在一处获得两种交付选项。 Getir 可在几分钟内处理按需配送的便利篮； GetirBüyük 为每周购物提供品种更丰富的当日大篮送货服务。您可以根据需要在对话中在它们之间进行切换。

您可以使用自然语言搜索产品并查看实时价格和库存，从保存的地址中进行选择或添加新地址，以及添加、删除或批量更新购物车中的商品。询问诸如“计划周末的购物清单”之类的问题会生成一个您可以查看和确认的多项目清单。特色交易和推荐可在同一流程中获得。当您准备好订购时，即可在 Getir 应用程序或网络购物车中完成付款。

您的帐户和付款数据保留在 Getir 中。仅与 ChatGPT 共享履行订单所需的信息，并且付款数据绝不会发送到 ChatGPT。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0c3f3f51e88191851fe363.name: Who What Wear
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c3f3f51e88191851fe363.productIntro: Who What Wear 将女性时尚出版物的社论声音引入 ChatGPT。它就像拥有一位已经了解您品味的造型师一样——一旦您建立了简短的风格简介，每个时尚问题都会得到个性化的、品牌意识的答案，而不是通用的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c3f3f51e88191851fe363.productIntroEn: Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c3f3f51e88191851fe363.longDescription:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c3f3f51e88191851fe363.longDescriptionZh:
Who What Wear 将女性时尚出版物的社论声音引入 ChatGPT。它就像拥有一位已经了解您品味的造型师一样——一旦您建立了简短的风格简介，每个时尚问题都会得到个性化的、品牌意识的答案，而不是通用的答案。

设置大约需要一分钟。引导式四步小部件会询问您的风格词（低调奢华、定制、法式、运动、潮流等）、您实际购买的现代、奢华、牛仔布和配饰品牌、您乐意借用的时尚偶像，以及您满意的价格范围。配置文件是按用户保存的，因此它可以跨对话进行，而不是每次打开 ChatGPT 时都重新开始。

入职后，三件事变得有用。

购买特定商品。告诉应用程序你要找什么——“给我找一件 250 英镑以下的黑色西装外套”、“我需要一件冬季婚礼外套”、“我应该买什么牛仔裤”——它会根据你已经购买过的品牌返回三到五个选项，再加上围绕这件单品打造的完整服装：上衣、下衣、脚上穿什么，以及一两个配饰。目的是留下一个可穿戴的答案，而不是一个链接列表。

编辑灵感。如果询问您现在应该穿什么或看什么，该应用程序会从 Who What Wear UK 的实时编辑提要中提取新鲜文章，然后使用每篇文章上的品牌和类别标签挑选两到三篇符合您品味的文章。这些精选内容以出版物自己的视觉语言呈现为水平轮播卡片：编辑图片、踢球者、标题、署名信用以及直接返回 whowhatwear.com 上文章的链接。

完善您的个人资料。口味发生变化。重新打开入门以更新任何答案（并且仅更新您想要更改的答案），或者如果您是全新的，则完全重置个人资料。

有几件事值得了解。编辑提要是“Who What Wear UK”，因此内容在声音、货币和季节性方面都倾向于英国风格。推荐始终以真实的 Who What Wear 文章或从您提供的列表中提取的品牌建议为基础——应用程序不会发明 URL、图像或文章来填写结果，并且轮播仅在存在要附加的真实链接和图像时才会呈现。如果提要在某一天没有任何相关内容，您会得到诚实的答复，而不是捏造的答复。
该应用程序不是什么：它不涵盖男士时尚、美容产品搜索、家居装饰或非时尚购物。它不会显示实时零售商库存或实时价格。如果请求超出此范围，它会直接说明而不是猜测。

由《Who What Wear》的出版商 Future PLC 打造。

Daft.ie, Ireland’s leading property platform, brings home search directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Discover properties for sale across Ireland using natural language - no forms, no filters, just straightforward conversation.

From budget and bedroom count to property type, BER rating, and specific locations, Daft.ie makes exploring what’s for sale in Ireland clear and efficient - all through natural conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_69ae143489d8819194ccdba7.name: Angler Adventures: Lure Guide
plugin_asdk_app_69ae143489d8819194ccdba7.description: 根据湖泊条件匹配诱饵
plugin_asdk_app_69ae143489d8819194ccdba7.productIntro: 别再猜测了。开始匹配模式。
plugin_asdk_app_69ae143489d8819194ccdba7.productIntroEn: Stop guessing. Start matching the pattern.
plugin_asdk_app_69ae143489d8819194ccdba7.longDescription:
Stop guessing. Start matching the pattern.

Angler Adventures: Lure Guide helps bass anglers choose the right lure for the conditions they’re fishing.

Tell the advisor what you’re seeing on the water—structure, clarity, weather, wind, and temperature—and it recommends the best lures to throw right now.

The system is built on the same fishing logic used in the Angler Adventures mobile game, where players learn how bass behavior changes based on environment and conditions. This companion app applies that same decision engine to real-world fishing, using the same environmental logic and original artwork from the game.

Instead of endless gear lists or vague advice, you get ranked recommendations and clear guidance on how to fish each lure.
plugin_asdk_app_69ae143489d8819194ccdba7.longDescriptionZh:
别再猜测了。开始匹配模式。

钓鱼者冒险：诱饵指南可帮助鲈鱼垂钓者根据钓鱼条件选择合适的诱饵。

告诉顾问您在水面上看到的情况——结构、透明度、天气、风和温度——它会推荐现在最好的鱼饵。

该系统建立在与《Angler Adventures》手机游戏中相同的钓鱼逻辑之上，玩家可以在游戏中了解鲈鱼的行为如何根据环境和条件而变化。这个配套应用程序将相同的决策引擎应用于现实世界的钓鱼，使用游戏中相同的环境逻辑和原创艺术作品。

您不会得到无休止的装备列表或模糊的建议，而是获得排名建议和如何钓鱼每个诱饵的清晰指导。

Where should I fish today on the lake?
defaultPromptsZh: 今天我应该在睡莲周围扔什么？
今天我应该在湖里哪里钓鱼？

plugin_asdk_app_6a47e8e914688191a099b19e.description: 您的承包商投标公平吗？
plugin_asdk_app_6a47e8e914688191a099b19e.productIntro: RemodelerIQ 帮助房主避免在装修上支付过高的费用。描述或粘贴承包商的出价，RemodelerIQ 会根据公平性和风险对其进行 0-100 分的评分，然后标记诸如押金金额过大、范围模糊以及缺少许可证或付款计划等问题。每个数字都基于真实数据——BLS 贸易工资、Zonda 成本与价值基准以及 152 个美国大都市的区域成本调整。您还可以询问您所在州的厨房、浴室、屋顶或附加设施的成本是多少，或者公平贸易劳动力费率是多少。免费，无需注册，只读。
plugin_asdk_app_6a47e8e914688191a099b19e.productIntroEn: RemodelerIQ helps homeowners avoid overpaying on renovations. Describe or paste a contractor's bid and RemodelerIQ scores it 0–100 for fairness and risk, then flags problems like oversized deposits, vague scope, and missing permits or payment schedules. Every number is grounded in real data — BLS trade wages, Zonda Cost vs. Value benchmarks, and regional cost adjustments across 152 U.S.
plugin_asdk_app_6a47e8e914688191a099b19e.longDescription: RemodelerIQ helps homeowners avoid overpaying on renovations. Describe or paste a contractor's bid and RemodelerIQ scores it 0–100 for fairness and risk, then flags problems like oversized deposits, vague scope, and missing permits or payment schedules. Every number is grounded in real data — BLS trade wages, Zonda Cost vs. Value benchmarks, and regional cost adjustments across 152 U.S. metros. You can also ask what a kitchen, bath, roof, or addition should cost in your state, or what fair trade labor rates are. Free, no signup, read-only.

plugin_asdk_app_6a0c679f4dd08191b7a7a48d.productIntro: Skylit Studio 将有意义的时刻变成个性化印刷品。选择一模一样的夜空（星图）、一模一样的月亮（月相打印）或重要地点的风格化地图（位置图）。描述某个场合，例如婚礼、出生或周年纪念日，并在您完善它时构建内联预览。选择尺寸和饰面，调整主题、形状、颜色和措辞，并添加可选的礼品包装。当看起来合适时，请安全地检查，Skylit 会打印并运送成品，准备赠送或悬挂。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c679f4dd08191b7a7a48d.productIntroEn: Skylit Studio turns a meaningful moment into a personalised print. Choose the night sky exactly as it looked (a star map), the moon exactly as it appeared (a moon phase print), or a stylised map of a place that matters (a location map). Describe the occasion, such as a wedding, a birth, or an anniversary, and an inline preview builds as you refine it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c679f4dd08191b7a7a48d.longDescription: Skylit Studio turns a meaningful moment into a personalised print. Choose the night sky exactly as it looked (a star map), the moon exactly as it appeared (a moon phase print), or a stylised map of a place that matters (a location map). Describe the occasion, such as a wedding, a birth, or an anniversary, and an inline preview builds as you refine it. Choose a size and finish, adjust the theme, shape, colours, and wording, and add optional gift wrapping. When it looks right, check out securely and Skylit prints and ships the finished piece, ready to give or hang.

plugin_asdk_app_69a5a869812c81919fcd84ec.productIntroEn: atHome.lu, Luxembourg’s leading real estate platform, now integrates directly into your ChatGPT experience.
plugin_asdk_app_69a5a869812c81919fcd84ec.longDescription:
atHome.lu, Luxembourg’s leading real estate platform, now integrates directly into your ChatGPT experience.

Search for apartments, houses, and investment opportunities using natural language — just describe what you’re looking for. Browse listings with photos, pricing, and key details directly in the chat, displayed in a smooth carousel format.

Try prompts like:
- Show me 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Luxembourg City under €1,700
- Find houses for sale in Bettembourg with a garden under €1.5M
- I’m looking for a penthouse with an open view in Ettelbruck
- Show traditional farmhouses to renovate in Diekirch

Whether you’re filtering by budget, size, location, or specific features, atHome.lu helps you instantly explore real estate opportunities across Luxembourg and the Greater Region — all within the flow of your conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_69a5a869812c81919fcd84ec.longDescriptionZh:
atHome.lu 是卢森堡领先的房地产平台，现已直接集成到您的 ChatGPT 体验中。

尝试如下提示：
- 显示卢森堡市出租 1,700 欧元以下的 2 居室公寓
- 查找贝登堡带花园的待售房屋，价格低于 150 万欧元
- 我正在埃特尔布鲁克寻找一套视野开阔的顶层公寓
- 展示迪基希 (Diekirch) 的传统农舍进行翻新

无论您是按预算、面积、位置还是特定功能进行筛选，atHome.lu 都可以帮助您立即探索卢森堡和大区的房地产机会 - 一切都在您的对话流程中。

plugin_asdk_app_6a49382adf148191b86d3a83.name: Peristyle Grocery Cart
plugin_asdk_app_6a49382adf148191b86d3a83.productIntro: Peristyle 将菜谱变成了可随时结账的购物车。搜索食谱，它会提取成分列表，将每件商品与克罗格或沃尔玛的真实产品进行匹配，并在将任何东西添加到购物车之前向您显示选项 - 包括尺寸、价格和品牌。连接您的克罗格帐户一次，即可直接通过助手购物，或者无需登录即可使用沃尔玛的目录。 Peristyle 会记住您的默认商店、取货或送货偏好、饮食需求和首选品牌，因此随着时间的推移，重复购物会变得更快。
plugin_asdk_app_6a49382adf148191b86d3a83.productIntroEn: Peristyle turns a recipe into a ready-to-checkout grocery cart. Search a recipe, and it pulls the ingredient list, matches each item to real products at Kroger or Walmart, and shows you the options — with size, price, and brand — before anything is added to a cart. Connect your Kroger account once to shop directly through the assistant, or use Walmart's catalog with no sign-in at all.
plugin_asdk_app_6a49382adf148191b86d3a83.longDescription:
Peristyle turns a recipe into a ready-to-checkout grocery cart. Search  a recipe, and it pulls the ingredient list, matches each item to real products at Kroger or  Walmart, and shows you the options — with size, price, and brand — before anything is added to a cart. Connect your Kroger account once to shop directly through the assistant, or use Walmart's catalog with no sign-in at all. Peristyle remembers your default store, pickup or delivery preference, dietary needs, and preferred brands, so repeat shopping gets faster over time.

You always see and approve product matches before they're added — Peristyle fills the cart
but never places the order or handles payment. Checkout happens on Kroger's or Walmart's own site.
plugin_asdk_app_6a49382adf148191b86d3a83.longDescriptionZh:
Peristyle 将菜谱变成了可随时结账的购物车。搜索食谱，它会提取成分列表，将每件商品与克罗格或沃尔玛的真实产品进行匹配，并在将任何东西添加到购物车之前向您显示选项 - 包括尺寸、价格和品牌。连接您的克罗格帐户一次，即可直接通过助手购物，或者无需登录即可使用沃尔玛的目录。 Peristyle 会记住您的默认商店、取货或送货偏好、饮食需求和首选品牌，因此随着时间的推移，重复购物会变得更快。

您始终可以在添加产品之前查看并批准产品匹配 — Peristyle 填充购物车
但从不下订单或处理付款。结帐在克罗格或沃尔玛自己的网站上进行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a184373d4b48191aca1d98b.name: Pearl Auto
plugin_asdk_app_6a184373d4b48191aca1d98b.productIntro: 人们经常对车辆的症状、维修需求或维护计划有疑问，但无法立即联系合格的机械师或汽车专家。
plugin_asdk_app_6a184373d4b48191aca1d98b.productIntroEn: People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.
plugin_asdk_app_6a184373d4b48191aca1d98b.longDescription:
People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.

Pearl Auto has licensed automotive technicians and mechanics review AI answers. Each AI answer is clearly marked by the expert as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

Automotive specialists across multiple areas review responses, including general automotive repair, diesel trucks, transmission & drivetrain, brakes & suspension, electrical systems, engine diagnostics, HVAC & climate control, and body & paint.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional automotive service.

Users can:
- Ask AI questions about vehicle symptoms, repair procedures, and maintenance
- See whether a certified mechanic marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get reassurance in the moment when an in-person mechanic is unavailable
plugin_asdk_app_6a184373d4b48191aca1d98b.longDescriptionZh:
人们经常对车辆的症状、维修需求或维护计划有疑问，但无法立即联系合格的机械师或汽车专家。

Pearl Auto 已获得许可的汽车技术人员和机械师审查人工智能答案。每个人工智能答案都会被专家明确标记为正确或错误，以便用户可以快速了解该信息是否可信。

多个领域的汽车专家会审查回复，包括一般汽车维修、柴油卡车、变速箱和动力传动系统、制动器和悬架、电气系统、发动机诊断、暖通空调和气候控制以及车身和油漆。

该应用程序仅供参考，不能取代专业的汽车服务。

用户可以：
- 向人工智能询问有关车辆症状、维修程序和维护的问题
- 查看经过认证的机械师是否将 AI 响应标记为正确或错误
- 当无法亲自维修时，您可以放心

plugin_asdk_app_6a16adcb24fc8191a889da86.name: Klinger-Vogt Immobilien
plugin_asdk_app_6a16adcb24fc8191a889da86.productIntro: Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于路德维希港、曼海姆和葡萄酒之路上的诺伊施塔特地区。该应用程序支持直观、基于位置的房产搜索，以搜索莱茵-内卡大都市区的待售、出租和投资机会。
plugin_asdk_app_6a16adcb24fc8191a889da86.productIntroEn: Klinger-Vogt Immobilien is a modern real estate company focused on the regions of Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße. The app enables intuitive, location-based property searches for properties for sale, rent, and investment opportunities in the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan area.
plugin_asdk_app_6a16adcb24fc8191a889da86.longDescription:
Klinger-Vogt Immobilien is a modern real estate company focused on the regions of Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße. The app enables intuitive, location-based property searches for properties for sale, rent, and investment opportunities in the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan area.

Instead of browsing through endless property listings, users can discover available houses, apartments, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This allows them to assess location, surroundings, and infrastructure much faster and more realistically.

By combining regional market expertise with modern technology, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien creates a transparent and user-friendly way to find suitable properties in the region.

Advantages at a Glance
Interactive property search through a modern map interface
Faster orientation in Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
Focus on selected properties in the Rhine-Neckar region
Easier comparison of different residential areas
More efficient searching through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced local real estate experts
Modern and intuitive mobile experience

Whether it’s a modern city apartment in Mannheim, a family home in Ludwigshafen, or an investment property in Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien offers a contemporary and transparent gateway to the regional real estate market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a16adcb24fc8191a889da86.longDescriptionZh:
Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于路德维希港、曼海姆和葡萄酒之路上的诺伊施塔特地区。该应用程序支持直观、基于位置的房产搜索，以搜索莱茵-内卡大都市区的待售、出租和投资机会。

用户无需浏览无休止的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上发现可用的房屋、公寓和投资房产。这使他们能够更快、更现实地评估位置、周围环境和基础设施。

通过将区域市场专业知识与现代技术相结合，Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 创造了一种透明且用户友好的方式来在该地区寻找合适的房产。

优势一览
通过现代地图界面进行交互式财产搜索
在路德维希港、曼海姆和葡萄酒之路上的诺伊施塔特更快地进行定位
更好地了解位置、基础设施和周围环境
专注于莱茵-内卡地区的精选房产
更容易比较不同住宅区
通过视觉导航更高效的搜索
直接接触经验丰富的当地房地产专家
现代直观的移动体验

无论是曼海姆的现代城市公寓、路德维希港的家庭住宅，还是葡萄酒之路上诺伊施塔特的投资房产，Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 都提供了通向区域房地产市场的现代化、透明的门户。

plugin_asdk_app_698ee2bb4c28819197bca2b9.longDescription:
The Experteer AI Career Assistant helps ambitious professionals and executives navigate job search more efficiently. Describe your target role, seniority, industry, and preferences, and get personalized, actionable guidance to discover relevant opportunities and refine your search strategy.

Use it to:

* Define and clarify your target roles (titles, scope, seniority)
* Translate your goals into better search criteria and keywords
* Explore adjacent roles and alternative title variations you may be missing
* Prioritize opportunities based on your preferences (industry, location, compensation focus, company type)
* Stay organized with a clearer shortlist and next steps for your search

More career-support capabilities may be added over time.
plugin_asdk_app_698ee2bb4c28819197bca2b9.longDescriptionZh:

用它来：

* 定义并阐明您的目标角色（头衔、范围、资历）
* 将您的目标转化为更好的搜索条件和关键词
* 探索您可能错过的相邻角色和替代头衔变体
* 根据您的偏好（行业、地点、薪酬重点、公司类型）优先考虑机会
* 通过更清晰的候选名单和搜索的后续步骤保持井井有条

随着时间的推移，可能会增加更多的职业支持能力。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3d0b46d7d48191989225c7.productIntro: Hausmann Immobilien Makler 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于诺德施泰特、汉堡、德累斯顿和德国东部其他地区。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买、出售或租赁房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d0b46d7d48191989225c7.productIntroEn: Hausmann Immobilien Makler is a modern real estate company specializing in Norderstedt, Hamburg, Dresden, and other regions across Eastern Germany. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, sell, or rent properties.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d0b46d7d48191989225c7.longDescription:
Hausmann Immobilien Makler is a modern real estate company specializing in Norderstedt, Hamburg, Dresden, and other regions across Eastern Germany. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, sell, or rent properties.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can explore available houses, apartments, land plots, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, neighborhood, and surrounding infrastructure at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With extensive regional market expertise and innovative digital solutions, Hausmann Immobilien Makler helps buyers, sellers, investors, and renters find the right property throughout Northern and Eastern Germany.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
* Faster navigation across Norderstedt, Hamburg, Dresden, and Eastern Germany
* Better understanding of neighborhoods, infrastructure, and local amenities
* Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different cities and residential areas
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct access to experienced real estate professionals
* Modern, user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a condominium in Hamburg, a family home in Norderstedt, an investment property in Dresden, or real estate in one of Eastern Germany's emerging regions, Hausmann Immobilien Makler provides a modern, transparent, and convenient way to explore the regional property market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d0b46d7d48191989225c7.longDescriptionZh:
Hausmann Immobilien Makler 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于诺德施泰特、汉堡、德累斯顿和德国东部其他地区。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买、出售或租赁房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产。这使得一目了然地了解房产的位置、社区和周边基础设施，创造更快、更高效的房产搜索体验。

凭借丰富的区域市场专业知识和创新的数字解决方案，Hausmann Immobilien Makler 帮助买家、卖家、投资者和租户在德国北部和东部找到合适的房产。

主要优点

* 使用基于地图的现代界面进行交互式财产搜索
* 更快地导航诺德施泰特、汉堡、德累斯顿和东德
* 更好地了解社区、基础设施和当地便利设施
* 专注于精心挑选的住宅和投资物业
* 轻松比较不同城市和居住区
* 通过视觉导航更高效的房产搜索
* 直接接触经验丰富的房地产专业人士
* 现代、用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在汉堡寻找公寓、在诺德施泰特寻找家庭住宅、在德累斯顿寻找投资房产，还是在德国东部新兴地区之一寻找房地产，Hausmann Immobilien Makler 都能提供一种现代、透明且便捷的方式来探索该地区的房地产市场。
defaultPrompts: Properties in Hamburg
defaultPromptsZh: 汉堡的房产

plugin_asdk_app_69e091c072c0819180eaf0b4.name: Cowboy Model Finder
plugin_asdk_app_69e091c072c0819180eaf0b4.description: 找到您完美的牛仔电动自行车
plugin_asdk_app_69e091c072c0819180eaf0b4.productIntro: Cowboy Model Finder 可帮助骑手发现哪款 Cowboy 电动自行车最适合他们，而无需阅读规格表或手动比较数据表。
plugin_asdk_app_69e091c072c0819180eaf0b4.productIntroEn: The Cowboy Model Finder helps riders discover which Cowboy electric bike fits them best – without reading spec sheets or comparing datasheets manually.
plugin_asdk_app_69e091c072c0819180eaf0b4.longDescription:
The Cowboy Model Finder helps riders discover which Cowboy electric bike fits them best – without reading spec sheets or comparing datasheets manually.

Launch an interactive wizard that walks you through three quick questions (terrain, riding style, typical distance) and returns a personalized recommendation from Cowboy's lineup: Cruiser, Cruiser ST, Cross, and Cross ST. Or ask for a side-by-side comparison of two specific models and get a clean specs table right inside the conversation.

Built on the Model Context Protocol as a native MCP App, the wizard renders directly inside your AI chat – no browser tab switching, no account sign-up, no friction. Perfect for anyone exploring their first urban e-bike or comparing options before visiting a Cowboy store.
plugin_asdk_app_69e091c072c0819180eaf0b4.longDescriptionZh:
Cowboy Model Finder 可帮助骑手发现哪款 Cowboy 电动自行车最适合他们，而无需阅读规格表或手动比较数据表。

启动交互式向导，引导您回答三个快速问题（地形、骑行风格、典型距离），并返回 Cowboy 系列的个性化推荐：Cruiser、Cruiser ST、Cross 和 Cross ST。或者要求对两个特定型号进行并排比较，并在对话中获得清晰的规格表。

该向导作为本机 MCP 应用程序构建在模型上下文协议之上，直接在您的 AI 聊天中呈现 - 无需浏览器选项卡切换，无需帐户注册，无摩擦。非常适合任何探索他们的第一辆城市电动自行车或在参观牛仔商店之前比较选择的人。
defaultPrompts: Find the right Cowboy e-bike via the interactive wizard
defaultPromptsZh: 通过交互式向导找到合适的牛仔电动自行车

plugin_asdk_app_69782e67a3c0819198e29e2f.description: 查找汽车、电子产品、商品
plugin_asdk_app_69782e67a3c0819198e29e2f.productIntro: Chotot：满足您所需一切的一站式市场
plugin_asdk_app_69782e67a3c0819198e29e2f.productIntroEn: Chotot: One-stop marketplace for everything you need
plugin_asdk_app_69782e67a3c0819198e29e2f.longDescription:
Chotot: One-stop marketplace for everything you need

Chotot is Vietnam's leading one-stop platform for buying and selling, designed to meet your needs at every stage of life. Whether you are looking for a new home, upgrading your vehicle, or decluttering your house, we connect you with millions of buyers and sellers nationwide to make trading simple, efficient, and reliable.

Why you will love using Chotot:

- Discover great-value items quickly: Explore a wide range of listings—from vehicles to home essentials—tailored to your budget and location.
- Shop smart for quality pre-owned goods: Find secondhand electronics, furniture, and fashion at wallet-friendly prices.
- Trade with more confidence: Review listing details and seller information to make more informed decisions.

As part of the Carousell Group, Chotot is committed to empowering Vietnamese daily life through recommerce. We strive to meet all your needs at every stage of life while promoting smart, sustainable consumption choices.
plugin_asdk_app_69782e67a3c0819198e29e2f.longDescriptionZh:
Chotot：满足您所需一切的一站式市场

Chotot 是越南领先的一站式买卖平台，旨在满足您人生各个阶段的需求。无论您是在寻找新房、升级车辆还是整理房屋，我们都会为您与全国数百万买家和卖家建立联系，让交易变得简单、高效、可靠。

为什么您会喜欢使用 Chotot：

- 快速发现超值物品：探索根据您的预算和位置量身定制的各种列表（从车辆到家居必需品）。
- 明智地购买优质二手商品：以实惠的价格找到二手电子产品、家具和时装。
- 更加自信地进行交易：查看列表详细信息和卖家信息，以做出更明智的决定。

作为 Carousell 集团的一部分，Chotot 致力于通过电子商务增强越南人的日常生活。我们努力满足您人生各个阶段的所有需求，同时促进明智、可持续的消费选择。
