plugin_asdk_app_69c2b84775a88191be245914.longDescription:
Find your dream car in Portugal using everyday language. Skip the complex filters and search forms. With Standvirtual, simply describe what you're looking for - "SUV with low milage great for family of 4 " or "recent model, city car"

Key features:
1. Smart search - Describe your ideal car in natural language
2. Relevant results - Get information about any listing and compare between options
3. Interactive refinement - Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search 

Whether you're a first-time buyer or seasoned car enthusiast, Standvirtual makes car buying as simple as having a conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_69c2b84775a88191be245914.longDescriptionZh:
使用日常语言在葡萄牙寻找您梦想的汽车。跳过复杂的过滤器和搜索表单。使用 Standvirtual，只需描述您要寻找的内容 -“适合 4 口之家的低里程 SUV”或“最新车型，城市汽车”

主要特点：
1. 智能搜索——用自然语言描述您的理想汽车
2. 相关结果 - 获取有关任何列表的信息并在选项之间进行比较
3. 互动细化 - 提出后续问题以缩小搜索范围 

无论您是首次购买者还是经验丰富的汽车爱好者，Standvirtual 都能让汽车购买变得像交谈一样简单。

plugin_asdk_app_694af876013c8191ac0c6b83.productIntroEn: RIFO Home makes it easy to search homes for sale and rent through conversation. Simply describe what you’re looking for — location, budget, commute, schools, neighborhood, lifestyle, or nearby places — and explore listings that match your needs.
plugin_asdk_app_694af876013c8191ac0c6b83.longDescription:
RIFO Home makes it easy to search homes for sale and rent through conversation.
Simply describe what you’re looking for — location, budget, commute, schools, neighborhood, lifestyle, or nearby places — and explore listings that match your needs.

Go beyond standard home search filters with location-aware discovery. Find homes near parks, schools, supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, and other points of interest, or search based on preferences around transit, highways, railways, and surrounding infrastructure. You can also search by school boundary, nearby places, and intersections to discover homes in the areas that fit your daily life.

Try asking things like:
• Find 2 bedroom detached house for sale near schools and parks in Markham under $2M.
• Show me 1 bedroom condo rentals near a subway station under $2,500 in Yonge and Finch.
• Are there any 3-bedroom townhouses in Richmond Hill under $1.2M that are located away from highways and power lines?
plugin_asdk_app_694af876013c8191ac0c6b83.longDescriptionZh:
RIFO Home 让您可以通过对话轻松搜索待售和出租的房屋。
只需描述您要寻找的内容 - 位置、预算、通勤、学校、社区、生活方式或附近的地方 - 并探索符合您需求的列表。

通过位置感知发现超越标准家庭搜索过滤器。查找公园、学校、超市、咖啡馆、餐馆和其他兴趣点附近的房屋，或根据对交通、高速公路、铁路和周边基础设施的偏好进行搜索。您还可以按学校边界、附近地点和十字路口进行搜索，以找到适合您日常生活的区域的房屋。

尝试询问以下问题：
• 在万锦市学校和公园附近寻找 2 居室独立式住宅出售，价格低于 200 万美元。
• 显示Yonge 和Finch 地铁站附近的一居室公寓租金低于2,500 美元。

plugin_asdk_app_69fd49f32eb48191b5774e7f.productIntroEn: Anvaya is your all inclusive wedding planning platform, brought into ChatGPT. Manage your weddings guest list and RSVPs, track your budget against real spend, compare vendor quotes, and see what's next on your to-do list.
plugin_asdk_app_69fd49f32eb48191b5774e7f.longDescription:
Anvaya is your all inclusive wedding planning platform, brought into ChatGPT. Manage your weddings guest list and RSVPs, track your budget against real spend, compare vendor quotes, and see what's next on your to-do list.

Ask "how's our wedding going?" for an overview, "who hasn't replied to the reception yet?" to spot per-event gaps, or "compare my photographers" to put quotes side by side. Each answer renders an interactive widget tied to your actual wedding data not a static summary. Actions that change things, like sending RSVP reminders or updating a budget line, go through a quick confirmation step so nothing happens by accident.

Anvaya is purpose-built for multi-day weddings, including South Asian celebrations across: Mehndi, Haldi, Sangeet, Ceremony, Receptions, and more. Anvaya works great for single-day weddings too. Couples, parents, and the wedding party can plan together from one shared workspace at https://anvaya.love.
plugin_asdk_app_69fd49f32eb48191b5774e7f.longDescriptionZh:
Anvaya 是您的全包式婚礼策划平台，已纳入 ChatGPT。管理您的婚礼宾客名单和回复，根据实际支出跟踪您的预算，比较供应商报价，并查看待办事项列表上的下一步。

问“我们的婚礼进行得怎么样？”有关概述，“谁还没有回复接待？”找出每个事件的差距，或者“比较我的摄影师”并排引用。每个答案都会呈现一个与您的实际婚礼数据相关的交互式小部件，而不是静态摘要。改变事情的行动，例如发送回复提醒或更新预算线，都会经过快速确认步骤，因此不会发生意外。

Anvaya 专为多日婚礼而设计，包括南亚庆祝活动：Mehndi、Haldi、Sangeet、仪式、招待会等。 Anvaya 也非常适合单日婚礼。夫妻、父母和婚礼派对可以在 https://anvaya.love 的一个共享工作空间中共同计划。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5bb283d24481918813e6ef.productIntro: Liftosaur 是一款可编写脚本的锻炼应用程序。它使用语言“Liftoscript”来定义锻炼。该插件允许用户编写和管理 Liftoscript 程序、锻炼历史、练习、健身器材、测量等。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bb283d24481918813e6ef.productIntroEn: Liftosaur is a scriptable workout app. It uses language "Liftoscript" to define workouts. The plugin lets users to write and manage Liftoscript programs, workout history, exercises, gym equipment, measurements, etc.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bb283d24481918813e6ef.longDescription:
Liftosaur is a scriptable workout app. It uses language "Liftoscript" to define workouts. The plugin lets users to write and manage Liftoscript programs, workout history, exercises, gym equipment, measurements, etc.

Free reference tools provide Liftoscript syntax, examples, program design guidance, built-in programs, and exercise names.

Private account tools require the user to authenticate with Liftosaur and have an active subscription before reading or changing programs, history, gyms, equipment, exercise settings, or measurements.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5bb283d24481918813e6ef.longDescriptionZh:
Liftosaur 是一款可编写脚本的锻炼应用程序。它使用语言“Liftoscript”来定义锻炼。该插件允许用户编写和管理 Liftoscript 程序、锻炼历史、练习、健身器材、测量等。

免费参考工具提供 Liftoscript 语法、示例、程序设计指南、内置程序和练习名称。

私人帐户工具要求用户在阅读或更改程序、历史记录、健身房、设备、锻炼设置或测量结果之前通过 Liftosaur 进行身份验证并拥有有效订阅。

plugin_asdk_app_69dcbe3a6f308191a189f620.productIntro: Immobiliare.it 应用程序是意大利第一大房地产分类平台，是为您找到完美住宅的最佳方式。
plugin_asdk_app_69dcbe3a6f308191a189f620.productIntroEn: The Immobiliare.it app, Italy’s No. 1 real estate classifieds platform, is the best way to find the perfect home for you.
plugin_asdk_app_69dcbe3a6f308191a189f620.longDescription:
The Immobiliare.it app, Italy’s No. 1 real estate classifieds platform, is the best way to find the perfect home for you.

Browse thousands of listings for homes for sale, for rent, and at auction in Rome, Milan, Naples, Turin, Genoa, Bologna, Florence, as well as in many other cities and small towns across Italy.

Find the perfect home for you
• Choose a city, neighborhood, or location, or draw your search area directly on the map.
• Filter listings by price, size, number of rooms, and the features you are looking for.
• Save your favorite listings, hide the ones you are less interested in, and add personal notes.
• Get app and email notifications for new listings or price changes by saving your search.
• Easily find your saved searches and listings again thanks to synchronization across the app, website, and all your devices.
plugin_asdk_app_69dcbe3a6f308191a189f620.longDescriptionZh:
Immobiliare.it 应用程序是意大利第一大房地产分类平台，是为您找到完美住宅的最佳方式。

浏览罗马、米兰、那不勒斯、都灵、热那亚、博洛尼亚、佛罗伦萨以及意大利许多其他城市和小镇的数千个待售、出租和拍卖房屋列表。

找到最适合您的家
• 选择城市、社区或位置，或直接在地图上绘制搜索区域。
• 按价格、面积、房间数量以及您正在寻找的功能过滤列表。
• 保存您最喜欢的列表，隐藏您不太感兴趣的列表，并添加个人注释。
• 通过保存搜索来获取有关新列表或价格变化的应用程序和电子邮件通知。
• 由于应用程序、网站和所有设备之间的同步，可以轻松地再次找到您保存的搜索和列表。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4c509b3710819193e4d03b.name: NiceBabyName — Nameology
plugin_asdk_app_6a4c509b3710819193e4d03b.productIntro: NiceBabyName 使用整体姓名学（《四个方面》一书中的“四个方面”方法）帮助父母查找、分析和比较婴儿的名字。给它一个名字，它就会返回该名称的主宰行星、气质、上升星座和上升程度，以及含义、个性解读和新生儿好感度注释。给它两到五个名字，它会并排比较它们，并标记出最适合新生儿的名字，以及每个名字的优点和缺点。它还可以通过开头字母、性别和文化起源来搜索包含 160,000 多个姓名的数据库，以收集候选人。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4c509b3710819193e4d03b.productIntroEn: NiceBabyName helps parents find, analyze, and compare baby names using Holistic Nameology — the "Four Aspects" method from the book The Four Aspects. Give it one name and it returns that name's Governing Planet, Temperament, Rising Sign, and Rising Degree, with meanings, a personality reading, and newborn-favorability notes.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4c509b3710819193e4d03b.longDescription: NiceBabyName helps parents find, analyze, and compare baby names using Holistic Nameology — the "Four Aspects" method from the book The Four Aspects. Give it one name and it returns that name's Governing Planet, Temperament, Rising Sign, and Rising Degree, with meanings, a personality reading, and newborn-favorability notes. Give it two to five names and it compares them side by side and flags which are most favorable for a newborn, with each name's strengths and pitfalls. It can also search a database of 160,000+ names by starting letters, gender, and cultural origin to gather candidates. English names are read from their pronunciation, which the app asks the user to confirm; Persian and Arabic names are read exactly from their own letters. The parents' names can be included to refine the reading. Works in English, Persian, and Arabic. For guidance and reflection only.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4c509b3710819193e4d03b.longDescriptionZh: NiceBabyName 使用整体姓名学（《四个方面》一书中的“四个方面”方法）帮助父母查找、分析和比较婴儿的名字。给它一个名字，它就会返回该名称的主宰行星、气质、上升星座和上升程度，以及含义、个性解读和新生儿好感度注释。给它两到五个名字，它会并排比较它们，并标记出最适合新生儿的名字，以及每个名字的优点和缺点。它还可以通过开头字母、性别和文化起源来搜索包含 160,000 多个姓名的数据库，以收集候选人。英文名字是根据发音读出的，应用程序会要求用户确认；波斯语和阿拉伯语的名字完全是根据它们自己的字母来读的。可以包括父母的名字以完善阅读。支持英语、波斯语和阿拉伯语。仅供指导和反思。
defaultPrompts: What does nameology say about the name Ava? Her mom is Sarah and her dad is David.
We're choosing between Maya, Lina, and Ava for our baby girl. Which is most favorable?
Suggest Persian girl names starting with "A", then read the best one for us.
defaultPromptsZh: 名字学对艾娃这个名字有什么看法？她的妈妈是莎拉，她的爸爸是大卫。

建议以“A”开头的波斯女孩名字，然后为我们读出最好的一个。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1e9b4d435c819197612ace.longDescription:
Tawadoo: Buy, Sell & Bid — Morocco's #1 Free Marketplace 🇲🇦

Experience the future of smart shopping with Tawadoo — the ultimate free marketplace to buy, sell, and bid in Morocco. From Casablanca and Rabat to Marrakech, Agadir, Fès, and Tangier, discover thousands of local listings near you. 🎯

Looking for a smarter way to shop or sell? Tawadoo puts the thrill of live auctions and the power of direct negotiation right at your fingertips — whether you're decluttering your home or hunting for that perfect find.

Why Tawadoo?
More than a classifieds app — Tawadoo is an integrated platform that combines the proximity of local markets with competitive auctions and an immersive, social experience built on photos and videos, ensuring transparency and trust in every transaction. 💡

Key Features:
✅ AI-Powered Listings — Our AI automatically generates compelling titles and descriptions to maximise your visibility and search ranking. 🤖
✅ Auto-Translation — Post in French or Arabic; Tawadoo translates your listing into the buyer's language for a seamless experience. 🌍
✅ Photos & Video — HD photos and short videos so buyers see your items from every angle. 📸
✅ 3 Ways to Sell — Fixed price, negotiated offers, or live auctions with real-time bidding. 🤝
✅ Analytics Dashboard — Track listing performance, views, and sales stats in real-time. 📈
✅ Precise Geolocation — Find and sell right in your neighbourhood, from Casablanca to Agadir. 📍
✅ Verified Profiles & Secure Messaging — A trusted community with privacy-first chat. 🔒

Browse Categories:
🔹 Real Estate: Apartments, houses, offices
🔹 Motors: Cars, motorcycles, spare parts
🔹 High-Tech: Smartphones, laptops, electronics
🔹 Fashion: Clothing, jewellery, accessories
🔹 Home & Garden: Furniture, décor, DIY
🔹 Services & Jobs: Job offers and professional services
🔹 Pets: Everything for your companions

Tawadoo Coins: Win & Save! 💰
Boost your experience with Tawadoo Coins. Earn by playing the Daily Lucky Wheel, rating your partners, or referring friends. Buy Coins directly in-app for an instant boost. Use them to feature listings, join auctions as a security deposit, or extend your publication limits.

Security & Compliance 🛡️
Your safety is our top priority. Compliant with Law 09-08 — you have the right to access, rectify, and object to the processing of your data. Authorised by the CNDP under N°A-W-1438/2025.
🔹 Verified Profiles · Secure Messaging · Your data is never sold.

How It Works:
1️⃣ Browse — Explore thousands of local listings across Morocco.
2️⃣ Connect — Chat directly with sellers via secure messaging.
3️⃣ Close — Negotiate and finalise your deal with ease.

plugin_asdk_app_6a212790a6648191a52b1082.name: Din Bostad
plugin_asdk_app_6a212790a6648191a52b1082.productIntro: Din Bostad 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 内部搜索瑞典房地产市场。使用它来获取有关查找、搜索或浏览瑞典待售房产的任何提示：公寓（lägenheter、bostadsrätter）、独立屋（villor、hus）、联排别墅（radhus）、小屋（stugor）、地块（tomter）或瑞典的任何待售房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a212790a6648191a52b1082.productIntroEn: Din Bostad helps users search the Swedish real estate market from inside ChatGPT. Use it for any prompt about finding, searching or browsing Swedish properties for sale: apartments (lägenheter, bostadsrätter), houses (villor, hus), townhouses (radhus), cabins (stugor), plots (tomter), or any for-sale property in Sweden.
plugin_asdk_app_6a212790a6648191a52b1082.longDescription:
Din Bostad helps users search the Swedish real estate market from inside ChatGPT. Use it for any prompt about finding, searching or browsing Swedish properties for sale: apartments (lägenheter, bostadsrätter), houses (villor, hus), townhouses (radhus), cabins (stugor), plots (tomter), or any for-sale property in Sweden.

The assistant resolves place names the user mentions to specific administrative locations (län, kommun,
area, place, street), then queries the listings index with structured filters such as price range, property
type, room count, living area, plot area, facilities (pool, balcony, garage, fireplace), energy class, viewing
windows, nearby points of interest (water, parks, schools, transit), publication recency, and sort order.
Constraints from earlier turns are carried forward, so users can refine or change direction without
restating everything.

Matching for-sale listings render on an interactive map widget with a sidebar list and a fullscreen
inspector for individual properties. Each listing links to the full advert on dinbostad.se, where the user can see all photos and viewing times, book a viewing, or contact the agent.

Example prompts: "Villor i Lund och Malmö med minst 5 rum, tomt över 800 kvadratmeter och
energiklass C eller bättre", "Radhus under 5 miljoner i Helsingborg och Lund, minst 4 rum", "Hus nära
vatten i Bohuslän med pool", "Three-bedroom villas in Malmö under 8 million SEK", "Cabins for sale in
Värmland", "Newest listings in Umeå".
plugin_asdk_app_6a212790a6648191a52b1082.longDescriptionZh:
Din Bostad 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 内部搜索瑞典房地产市场。使用它来获取有关查找、搜索或浏览瑞典待售房产的任何提示：公寓（lägenheter、bostadsrätter）、独立屋（villor、hus）、联排别墅（radhus）、小屋（stugor）、地块（tomter）或瑞典的任何待售房产。

助手将用户提到的地名解析为特定的行政位置（län、kommun、
区域、地点、街道），然后使用结构化过滤器（例如价格范围、属性）查询列表索引
类型、房间数、居住面积、地块面积、设施（游泳池、阳台、车库、壁炉）、能源等级、景观
窗口、附近的兴趣点（水、公园、学校、交通）、出版时间和排序顺序。
先前转弯的限制将被延续，因此用户可以改进或改变方向，而无需
重述一切。

匹配的待售列表呈现在带有侧边栏列表和全屏的交互式地图小部件上
个别财产的检查员。每个列表都链接到 dinbostad.se 上的完整广告，用户可以在其中查看所有照片和观看时间、预订观看或联系代理商。

示例提示：“Villor i Lund och Malmö med minst 5 rum, tomt över 800 kvadratmeter och
energiklass Celler bättre", "Radhus under 5 miljoner i Helsingborg och Lund, minst 4 rum", "Hus nära
vatten i Bohuslän med pool”、“马尔默 800 万瑞典克朗以下的三居室别墅”、“在
Värmland”，“于默奥的最新房源”。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a0e01351481918283535f.productIntro: SKW Immobilien 是一家专门从事居特斯洛地区的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售居特斯洛及周边地区的房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a0e01351481918283535f.productIntroEn: SKW Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialised in the Gütersloh region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Gütersloh and the surrounding area.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a0e01351481918283535f.longDescription:
SKW Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialised in the Gütersloh region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Gütersloh and the surrounding area.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surroundings at a glance, making the property search significantly easier and more efficient.

With in-depth local market knowledge and personalised service, SKW Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Gütersloh real estate market.

Key Benefits

* Interactive map-based property search
* Faster orientation in Gütersloh and the surrounding region
* Better understanding of locations, infrastructure, and surroundings
* Focus on selected residential and investment properties in the region
* Easy comparison of different towns and communities
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for an apartment in Gütersloh, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, SKW Immobilien offers a modern and transparent way to explore the regional real estate market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a0e01351481918283535f.longDescriptionZh:
SKW Immobilien 是一家专门从事居特斯洛地区的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售居特斯洛及周边地区的房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产。这使得您可以一目了然地了解房产的位置、附近的基础设施和周围环境，从而使房产搜索变得更加容易和高效。

凭借深入的当地市场知识和个性化服务，SKW Immobilien 将现代数字解决方案与区域专业知识相结合，帮助买家、卖家和投资者驾驭居特斯洛房地产市场。

主要优点

* 基于交互式地图的房产搜索
* 在居特斯洛及周边地区更快的定位
* 更好地了解位置、基础设施和周围环境
* 专注于该地区选定的住宅和投资物业
* 轻松比较不同城镇和社区
* 通过视觉导航更高效的房产搜索
* 与经验丰富的房地产专业人士直接联系
* 现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在居特斯洛寻找公寓、周边地区的家庭住宅，还是有吸引力的投资机会，SKW Immobilien 都能提供一种现代、透明的方式来探索该地区的房地产市场。

plugin_asdk_app_69f256267d548191baa53a7b.longDescription:
Search for restaurants powered by Ordering.Tools, read their full menus — with prices, allergens, dietary options, and modifiers — and prepare orders ready for checkout. Ask "what gluten-free starters do you have at Yugo Bistro?" or "order me a margherita and a Coke from London Pub for pickup, my name is John, phone +359..." and the assistant builds the cart, validates pricing against the venue's live menu, and hands you a one-click checkout link to confirm and pay on the venue's own page.

Works across hundreds of independent restaurants, cafes, bars, and hotels — covering pickup, dine-in, and delivery. Every order receives the venue's allergen and dietary metadata, so you can flag concerns up front. We never auto-charge cards: you always confirm and pay on the venue's checkout page, exactly as if you'd browsed their site directly. Sign in once with your Ordering.Tools account to save name, phone, and email so future orders are one tap away.
plugin_asdk_app_69f256267d548191baa53a7b.longDescriptionZh:
搜索由 Ordering.Tools 提供支持的餐厅，阅读其完整菜单（包含价格、过敏原、饮食选项和修饰语）并准备好订单以供结账。问“Yugo Bistro 有哪些无麸质开胃菜？”或者“从伦敦酒吧给我订一杯玛格丽特酒和一杯可乐，我叫约翰，电话+359……”然后助理就会建立购物车，根据场地的实时菜单验证价格，并为您提供一键结账链接，以便在场地自己的页面上确认并付款。

与数百家独立餐厅、咖啡馆、酒吧和酒店合作，涵盖取货、堂食和送货服务。每个订单都会收到场地的过敏原和饮食元数据，因此您可以提前标记问题。我们从不自动充值卡：您始终在场地的结账页面上确认并付款，就像您直接浏览他们的网站一样。使用您的 Ordering.Tools 帐户登录一次即可保存姓名、电话和电子邮件，以便以后的订单只需轻轻一按即可。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3d598812508191acec8652.name: KLINGER Immobilien
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d598812508191acec8652.productIntro: KLINGER Immobilien 是一家专门从事柏林及周边大都市区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买和销售整个德国首都地区的房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d598812508191acec8652.productIntroEn: KLINGER Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Berlin and the surrounding metropolitan area. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, and sell properties throughout Germany's capital region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d598812508191acec8652.longDescription:
KLINGER Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Berlin and the surrounding metropolitan area. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, and sell properties throughout Germany's capital region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand each property's location, surrounding infrastructure, and neighborhood at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With extensive local market expertise and many years of experience in the Berlin real estate market, KLINGER Immobilien combines personalized service with modern digital solutions to help buyers and sellers navigate today's property market.

Key Benefits

Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster navigation throughout Berlin and the surrounding region
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
Easy comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient property search through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a condominium in Berlin, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, KLINGER Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and convenient way to explore the real estate market in Berlin and its surrounding region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d598812508191acec8652.longDescriptionZh:
KLINGER Immobilien 是一家专门从事柏林及周边大都市区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买和销售整个德国首都地区的房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产。这使得您可以一目了然地了解每个房产的位置、周边基础设施和社区，从而创造更快、更高效的房产搜索体验。

凭借丰富的本地市场专业知识和在柏林房地产市场的多年经验，KLINGER Immobilien 将个性化服务与现代数字解决方案相结合，帮助买家和卖家驾驭当今的房地产市场。

主要优点

使用基于地图的现代界面进行交互式财产搜索
整个柏林及周边地区的导航速度更快
更好地了解位置、基础设施和社区
专注于精心挑选的住宅和投资物业
轻松比较不同地区和城市
通过视觉导航更高效的房产搜索
与经验丰富的房地产专业人士直接联系
现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在柏林寻找公寓、周边地区的家庭住宅，还是有吸引力的投资机会，KLINGER Immobilien 都能提供一种现代、透明且便捷的方式来探索柏林及其周边地区的房地产市场。

Users can discover nearby restaurants, explore local offerings, ask questions, receive recommendations, and complete actions such as placing pickup orders with participating businesses.

plugin_asdk_app_6a0a8e670a648191a254f804.name: Rilev
plugin_asdk_app_6a0a8e670a648191a254f804.productIntro: Rilev 可让您将去识别化的自我理解上下文连接到 ChatGPT，以便回复可以更加与个人相关。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0a8e670a648191a254f804.productIntroEn: Rilev lets you connect de-identified self-understanding context to ChatGPT so responses can be more personally relevant.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0a8e670a648191a254f804.longDescription:
Rilev lets you connect de-identified self-understanding context to ChatGPT so responses can be more personally relevant.

After you authorize read-only access, ChatGPT can use your Rilev outcome patterns, labels, and safe explanations to personalize reflection, planning, journaling, habit support, and growth-focused conversations.

Rilev is for self-understanding and personal growth, not diagnosis, treatment, medication guidance, or professional care. The connector returns only de-identified context. Raw answers, item-level responses, identity information, payment data, Rilev Access Keys, and the full private report are not available through this connector.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0a8e670a648191a254f804.longDescriptionZh:
Rilev 可让您将去识别化的自我理解上下文连接到 ChatGPT，以便回复可以更加与个人相关。

在您授权只读访问权限后，ChatGPT 可以使用您的 Rilev 结果模式、标签和安全解释来个性化反思、计划、日记、习惯支持和以成长为重点的对话。

Rilev 用于自我理解和个人成长，而不是诊断、治疗、药物指导或专业护理。连接器仅返回未识别的上下文。原始答案、项目级响应、身份信息、付款数据、Rilev 访问密钥和完整的私人报告无法通过此连接器获得。

plugin_asdk_app_69ac46b15ff08191973b3742.name: Mondoir.art
plugin_asdk_app_69ac46b15ff08191973b3742.description: 寻找适合您空间的艺术品
plugin_asdk_app_69ac46b15ff08191973b3742.productIntro: Mondoir.art 是一个发现、收藏和理解当代艺术的平台。它通过一个结构化的生态系统连接收藏家、画廊和艺术家，该生态系统将传统艺术实践与人工智能辅助的见解和现代文档工具相结合。
plugin_asdk_app_69ac46b15ff08191973b3742.productIntroEn: Mondoir.art is a platform for discovering, collecting, and understanding contemporary art. It connects collectors, galleries, and artists through a structured ecosystem that combines traditional art practices with AI-assisted insights and modern documentation tools.
plugin_asdk_app_69ac46b15ff08191973b3742.longDescription:
Mondoir.art is a platform for discovering, collecting, and understanding contemporary art. It connects collectors, galleries, and artists through a structured ecosystem that combines traditional art practices with AI-assisted insights and modern documentation tools.

Through the Mondoir.art app, users can explore curated artworks, learn about artists and collections, and access contextual information about artworks, valuation, provenance, and editions. The platform is designed to make the art world easier to navigate by organizing information that is often fragmented across galleries, marketplaces, and social platforms.

Collectors can use the app to research artworks, track editions, and explore how contemporary art is presented and documented. Artists and galleries can present their work in a structured environment that supports discovery and documentation.

By integrating with ChatGPT, the Mondoir.art app allows users to ask questions about artists, artworks, exhibitions, and collecting — turning complex art information into clear and accessible conversations.
plugin_asdk_app_69ac46b15ff08191973b3742.longDescriptionZh:
Mondoir.art 是一个发现、收藏和理解当代艺术的平台。它通过一个结构化的生态系统连接收藏家、画廊和艺术家，该生态系统将传统艺术实践与人工智能辅助的见解和现代文档工具相结合。

通过 Mondoir.art 应用程序，用户可以探索精选的艺术品，了解艺术家和收藏品，并访问有关艺术品、估价、出处和版本的上下文信息。该平台旨在通过组织通常分散在画廊、市场和社交平台上的信息，让艺术世界更容易浏览。

收藏家可以使用该应用程序来研究艺术品、跟踪版本并探索当代艺术的呈现和记录方式。艺术家和画廊可以在支持发现和记录的结构化环境中展示他们的作品。

通过与 ChatGPT 集成，Mondoir.art 应用程序允许用户询问有关艺术家、艺术品、展览和收藏的问题，将复杂的艺术信息转化为清晰易懂的对话。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0bc182c08191a82909a0.productIntro: Immobilien Franzen 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于埃菲尔地区和特里尔地区。该应用程序提供了一种直观且基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售该地区的房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0bc182c08191a82909a0.productIntroEn: Immobilien Franzen is a modern real estate company specializing in the Eifel region and the Trier area. The app offers an intuitive and location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in the region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0bc182c08191a82909a0.longDescription:
Immobilien Franzen is a modern real estate company specializing in the Eifel region and the Trier area. The app offers an intuitive and location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in the region.

Instead of working through long and confusing property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, and plots directly on an interactive map. This makes the location of a property immediately understandable and makes the search process much more efficient and transparent.

With strong regional market expertise and a clear focus on the Eifel and Trier regions, Immobilien Franzen combines personal consultation with modern digital solutions for a contemporary real estate search experience.

Advantages at a glance

Interactive property search through a modern map view
Faster orientation within the Eifel region and Trier area
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
Focus on selected properties in the region
Easier comparison of different residential areas
More efficient searching through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced local real estate experts
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether it’s a charming house in the Eifel, a city apartment in Trier, or an attractive investment property – Immobilien Franzen offers a modern and transparent gateway to the regional real estate market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0bc182c08191a82909a0.longDescriptionZh:
Immobilien Franzen 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于埃菲尔地区和特里尔地区。该应用程序提供了一种直观且基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售该地区的房产。

用户可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓和地块，而不是浏览冗长且令人困惑的房产列表。这使得财产的位置可以立即被理解，并使搜索过程更加高效和透明。

凭借强大的区域市场专业知识以及对埃菲尔和特里尔地区的明确关注，Immobilien Franzen 将个人咨询与现代数字解决方案相结合，打造当代房地产搜索体验。

优势一览

通过现代地图视图进行交互式财产搜索
在埃菲尔地区和特里尔地区更快定位
更好地了解位置、基础设施和周围环境
专注于该地区的选定房产
更容易比较不同住宅区
通过视觉导航更高效的搜索
直接接触经验丰富的当地房地产专家
现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论是埃菲尔的迷人住宅、特里尔的城市公寓，还是有吸引力的投资房产——Immobilien Franzen 都提供了通往区域房地产市场的现代化、透明的门户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a468ab04fb081919990214f.name: Metz Immobilien
plugin_asdk_app_6a468ab04fb081919990214f.productIntro: Metz Immobilien 是一家专门从事法兰克福及周边地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售德国最具活力的经济地区之一的房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a468ab04fb081919990214f.productIntroEn: Metz Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in one of Germany's most dynamic economic regions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a468ab04fb081919990214f.longDescription:
Metz Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in one of Germany's most dynamic economic regions.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available apartments, houses, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to understand each property's location, surrounding infrastructure, and neighbourhood at a glance, creating a faster and more intuitive property search experience.

With in-depth market knowledge and personalised guidance, Metz Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Frankfurt real estate market with confidence.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
* Faster orientation in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region
* Better understanding of locations, infrastructure, and neighbourhoods
* Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
* Easier comparison of different districts and residential areas
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct access to experienced real estate professionals
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a condominium in the heart of Frankfurt, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, Metz Immobilien provides a modern and transparent way to explore the real estate market in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a468ab04fb081919990214f.longDescriptionZh:
Metz Immobilien 是一家专门从事法兰克福及周边地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售德国最具活力的经济地区之一的房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的公寓、房屋、土地和投资房产。这使得您可以更轻松地一目了然地了解每个房产的位置、周边基础设施和社区，从而创造更快、更直观的房产搜索体验。

凭借深入的市场知识和个性化指导，Metz Immobilien 将现代数字解决方案与区域专业知识相结合，帮助买家、卖家和投资者充满信心地驾驭法兰克福房地产市场。

主要优点

* 使用基于地图的现代界面进行交互式财产搜索
* 在法兰克福及周边地区更快的定位
* 更好地了解位置、基础设施和社区
* 专注于精心挑选的住宅和投资物业
* 更容易比较不同地区和住宅区
* 通过视觉导航更高效的房产搜索
* 直接接触经验丰富的房地产专业人士
* 现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在寻找法兰克福市中心的公寓、周边地区的家庭住宅，还是有吸引力的投资机会，Metz Immobilien 都能提供一种现代、透明的方式来探索美因河畔法兰克福及周边地区的房地产市场。

plugin_asdk_app_6a84ab2019f48191ac14ef00.productIntroEn: Maysynthel is a global fashion and lifestyle destination offering a curated selection of men's, women's, and children's fashion, bags, accessories, homeware, and lifestyle products. plugin_asdk_app_6a84ab2019f48191ac14ef00.longDescription:
Maysynthel is a global fashion and lifestyle destination offering a curated selection of men's, women's, and children's fashion, bags, accessories, homeware, and lifestyle products. From designer-inspired pieces and creative fashion to everyday essentials, Maysynthel focuses on accessible style, quality craftsmanship, and carefully quality-checked products for shoppers worldwide.

Maysynthel Shopping brings this experience directly into ChatGPT. Shoppers can discover products by style, category, price, availability, attributes, and other preferences; explore product details and exact variations; and check current price and stock before purchasing.

When ready to buy, Maysynthel Shopping can prepare the selected product or exact variation and provide a secure handoff to Maysynthel to complete the cart and checkout. Maysynthel serves customers internationally, with worldwide delivery across 130+ countries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84ab2019f48191ac14ef00.longDescriptionZh:
Maysynthel 是一个全球时尚和生活方式目的地，提供精选的男士、女士和儿童时装、箱包、配饰、家居用品和生活方式产品。从设计师灵感单品和创意时尚到日常必需品，Maysynthel 专注于为全球购物者提供平易近人的风格、优质的工艺和经过仔细质量检查的产品。

Maysynthel Shopping 将这种体验直接带入 ChatGPT。购物者可以根据款式、类别、价格、可用性、属性和其他偏好来发现产品；探索产品细节和确切的变化；并在购买前检查当前价格和库存。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8d35609a748191a4c10bd4.longDescription:
Search the RE/MAX Türkiye property portfolio without leaving ChatGPT. From homes for sale or rent to commercial spaces and land, browse listings published on remax.com.tr simply by describing what you're looking for in your own words.

Mention @REMAX Turkiye and tell it what you need — a three-bedroom apartment in a gated complex in Ataşehir, or a detached house near the coast in İzmir. The app reads your location, budget, room count and other preferences, then returns the listings that match.

When you find a plan you like, Chaiz links you to chaiz.com to read the full contract and check out online.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a1e1c646881919ea3a476.name: Când Reciclăm
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a1e1c646881919ea3a476.description: 布加勒斯特回收时间表
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a1e1c646881919ea3a476.productIntro: “我家街上的玻璃什么时候能捡起来？”只有在运营商发布答案的情况下才有真正的答案。 Când Reciclăm 向布加勒斯特居民提供第 1 区的实际每个地址收集日历（以及第 2 区的家庭垃圾），该日历摘自运营商的官方出版物，并链接到每一行的来源。对于不发布每个地址时间表的部门（3-6），它做了一些罕见的事情：它如此透明地说明 - 每个运营商发布了什么，没有发布什么，以及居民如何实际找到（调度号码，收集点，合作伙伴应用程序），所有源都与验证日期相关联。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a1e1c646881919ea3a476.productIntroEn: "When is the glass picked up on my street?" has a real answer only where operators publish one. Când Reciclăm gives Bucharest residents the actual per-address collection calendar for Sector 1 (and household waste for Sector 2), extracted from the operators' official publications and linked to the source on every row.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a1e1c646881919ea3a476.longDescription: "When is the glass picked up on my street?" has a real answer only where operators publish one. Când Reciclăm gives Bucharest residents the actual per-address collection calendar for Sector 1 (and household waste for Sector 2), extracted from the operators' official publications and linked to the source on every row. For sectors that don't publish per-address schedules (3–6), it does something rarer: it says so, transparently — what each operator does publish, what it doesn't, and how residents can actually find out (dispatch numbers, collection points, partner apps), all source-linked with verification dates. A practical sorting guide covers the hard cases: batteries, used cooking oil, medicines, e-waste, bulky items, textiles and SGR deposit-return — with concrete drop-off points. Free, no account, no ads.

plugin_asdk_app_6a165bf058208191b694d46e.productIntro: TuEspacio 将波多黎各的分类广告引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语（英语或西班牙语）询问，然后立即浏览岛上真人发布的本地列表。
plugin_asdk_app_6a165bf058208191b694d46e.productIntroEn: TuEspacio brings Puerto Rico's classifieds into ChatGPT. Ask in plain English — English or Spanish — and instantly browse local listings posted by real people across the island.
plugin_asdk_app_6a165bf058208191b694d46e.longDescription:
TuEspacio brings Puerto Rico's classifieds into ChatGPT. Ask in plain English — English or Spanish — and instantly browse local listings posted by real people across the island.

Search across six categories:

Real estate — homes, apartments and land for sale or rent
Vehicles — cars, trucks, motorcycles and boats
Marketplace — furniture, electronics, appliances and everyday items
Services — plumbers, electricians, beauty, repairs and more
Jobs — full-time, part-time and freelance openings
Explora — places to visit, restaurants and things to do
Filter by municipality, price, condition or category. See photos, prices and contact details right inside the chat, and tap through to message the seller on tuespaciopr.com.

Every listing is posted directly by Puerto Rican residents and small businesses, so what you see is what's actually available on the island today. TuEspacio is free to use and free to list — your space, your search, your Puerto Rico.
plugin_asdk_app_6a165bf058208191b694d46e.longDescriptionZh:
TuEspacio 将波多黎各的分类广告引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语（英语或西班牙语）询问，然后立即浏览岛上真人发布的本地列表。

跨六个类别搜索：

房地产 — 待售或出租的住宅、公寓和土地
车辆 — 汽车、卡车、摩托车和船只
市场——家具、电子产品、电器和日常用品
服务 — 水管工、电工、美容、维修等
职位空缺——全职、兼职和自由职业

plugin_asdk_app_6a766b80051c8191a0821d5b.longDescription:
Korea Concierge helps people navigate Korean secondhand shopping and practical life tasks from chat. Search Bunjang listings, inspect listing details, calculate an item quote, and create a reviewed purchase request. Every order is reviewed before payment, and the buyer receives a private order page with the quote, payment step, status, proof, and tracking.

The plugin also provides free, deterministic checks based on official Korean apartment transaction data. Users can inspect recent sale and rent records, compare a jeonse deposit with sale prices, or compare a monthly rent offer with similar transactions. These tools provide transaction data and clearly disclosed calculations, not brokerage or advice.

Curated living guides cover arrival administration, housing contracts, banking, property purchase procedure, and schools. Users can also submit a settling, housing-support, or education request for founder review. Korea Concierge operates as the principal seller for secondhand resale orders and as the service provider for accepted concierge engagements.

plugin_asdk_app_6a2920eb8a588191b9c6330a.longDescription:
Eva Buchholz Real Estate Management specializes in the brokerage and marketing of real estate in Munich and the surrounding Munich metropolitan area. The app provides a modern and intuitive way to discover properties in one of Germany’s most attractive regions and search specifically for suitable listings.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can explore available apartments, houses, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes location, infrastructure, and neighborhood characteristics immediately visible, creating a more transparent and efficient property search experience.

With extensive market knowledge, personalized advice, and a clear focus on Munich and its surrounding communities, Eva Buchholz Real Estate Management combines regional expertise with modern digital solutions.

Key Benefits at a Glance
Interactive property search through a modern map-based interface
Faster orientation within Munich and the surrounding Munich region
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and residential environment
Focus on selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient search through visual navigation
Direct contact with an experienced real estate expert
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you are looking for a stylish city apartment in Munich, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment property, Eva Buchholz Real Estate Management offers a modern and transparent gateway to the real estate market in Munich and the surrounding region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2920eb8a588191b9c6330a.longDescriptionZh:
Eva Buchholz 房地产管理公司专门从事慕尼黑及周边慕尼黑大都市区的房地产经纪和营销。该应用程序提供了一种现代且直观的方式来发现德国最具吸引力的地区之一的房产并专门搜索合适的列表。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的公寓、房屋和投资房产。这使得位置、基础设施和社区特征立即可见，从而创造更加透明和高效的房产搜索体验。

伊娃·布赫霍尔茨房地产管理公司凭借丰富的市场知识、个性化建议以及对慕尼黑及其周边社区的明确关注，将区域专业知识与现代数字解决方案相结合。

主要优点一览
通过基于地图的现代界面进行交互式财产搜索
在慕尼黑及其周边地区更快地定位
更好地了解位置、基础设施和居住环境
专注于该地区选定的住宅和投资物业
更容易比较不同地区和城市
通过视觉导航更高效的搜索
与经验丰富的房地产专家直接联系
现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在慕尼黑寻找时尚的城市公寓、周边地区的家庭住宅还是有吸引力的投资房产，Eva Buchholz 房地产管理公司都能为您提供通往慕尼黑及周边地区房地产市场的现代化、透明的门户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a45002da47481919ed2fb1f.productIntro: ApexLog 是车手的赛道日日志。将其连接到 ChatGPT 并用简单的语言询问您自己的驾驶历史记录：逐个区域比较两圈，查看您在哪里损失了时间，调出您在一次赛事中跑过的设置和轮胎状态，检查一组衬垫或轮胎上有多少圈，或者读取您最佳单圈的 GPS 轨迹 - 包括记录时的燃油和温度等 OBD 通道。它保存了您跑圈的完整信息——车辆、轮胎型号和车龄、每次设置、部件磨损、天气和赛道——因此助手会用您的真实数据进行回答。
plugin_asdk_app_6a45002da47481919ed2fb1f.productIntroEn: ApexLog is a track day logbook for drivers. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your own driving history in plain language: compare two laps sector by sector, see where you lost time, pull the setup and tyre state you ran at an event, check how many laps are on a set of pads or tyres, or read the GPS trace of your best lap — including OBD channels such as fuel and temperatures when they…
plugin_asdk_app_6a45002da47481919ed2fb1f.longDescription: ApexLog is a track day logbook for drivers. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your own driving history in plain language: compare two laps sector by sector, see where you lost time, pull the setup and tyre state you ran at an event, check how many laps are on a set of pads or tyres, or read the GPS trace of your best lap — including OBD channels such as fuel and temperatures when they were logged. It holds the full context around your laps — vehicle, tyre model and age, per-session setup, component wear, weather and track — so the assistant answers with your real data. The connector is read-only and scoped to your own account; it never changes or deletes anything. You bring your own ChatGPT plan, so there are no question limits.

plugin_asdk_app_6a802ea80f6c8191b3c22d96.productIntro: Monoblend AI Barista 将用户描述的口味与六种咖啡的 Monoblend 特色产品系列相匹配，然后支持后续的实际步骤。从巧克力味和低酸度、明亮的果味、礼物或晚上的无咖啡因咖啡等描述中，它会返回一个安全、一个好奇和一个狂野的选择，并附上匹配分数和每个选择的理由，并根据“太酸”或“我想要更饱满”等简单反馈来完善这些选择。
plugin_asdk_app_6a802ea80f6c8191b3c22d96.productIntroEn: Monoblend AI Barista matches a user's described taste to the six-coffee Monoblend specialty lineup and then supports the practical steps that follow. plugin_asdk_app_6a802ea80f6c8191b3c22d96.longDescription: Monoblend AI Barista matches a user's described taste to the six-coffee Monoblend specialty lineup and then supports the practical steps that follow. From a description such as chocolatey and low-acid, bright and fruity, a gift, or decaf for the evening, it returns a Safe, a Curious and a Wild pick with a match score and the reason each one fits, and refines those picks from plain feedback like 'too sour' or 'I want it fuller'. Beyond matching, it generates brewing recipes tuned per method and per bean, pairs coffee with a described dish or a photo of a plate, diagnoses a cup that came out bitter, sour or watery, compares two beans side by side, builds a guided tasting flight for guests and gifts, and explains acidity, body, roast and processing in plain language. The app is informational only: it does not sell coffee, display prices, take orders or report stock, and it declines rather than inventing commercial or store details it does not hold.
plugin_asdk_app_6a802ea80f6c8191b3c22d96.longDescriptionZh: Monoblend AI Barista 将用户描述的口味与六种咖啡的 Monoblend 特色产品系列相匹配，然后支持后续的实际步骤。从巧克力味和低酸度、明亮的果味、礼物或晚上的无咖啡因咖啡等描述中，它会返回一个安全、一个好奇和一个狂野的选择，并附上匹配分数和每个选择的理由，并根据“太酸”或“我想要更饱满”等简单反馈来完善这些选择。除了匹配之外，它还可以根据方法和咖啡豆生成调整的冲泡配方，将咖啡与所描述的菜肴或盘子的照片搭配，诊断一杯咖啡的苦味、酸味或水样，并排比较两种咖啡豆，为客人和礼物构建引导品尝之旅，并用简单的语言解释酸度、醇度、烘焙和加工过程。该应用程序仅供参考：它不销售咖啡、显示价格、接受订单或报告库存，并且它会拒绝，而不是发明它不掌握的商业或商店详细信息。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0ec1f7d2ac8191823fcd77.name: Tessun Immobilien
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ec1f7d2ac8191823fcd77.description: 慕尼黑和 ILT 房产
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ec1f7d2ac8191823fcd77.productIntro: Tessun Immobilien 应用程序使慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷的房产搜索更加清晰、更加注重本地化。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ec1f7d2ac8191823fcd77.productIntroEn: The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ec1f7d2ac8191823fcd77.longDescription:
The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

The app is designed not to make property searching more complicated, but more understandable — with a clear focus on location, regional expertise, and easier navigation through the real estate market around Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ec1f7d2ac8191823fcd77.longDescriptionZh:
Tessun Immobilien 应用程序使慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷的房产搜索更加清晰、更加注重本地化。

用户可以直接在交互式地图上查看可用的属性，而不是浏览长的属性列表。这样可以更轻松地快速了解哪个位置最适合他们的日常生活 - 无论是在慕尼黑、沃尔夫拉茨豪森、格雷茨里德还是周边地区。

更快的地理定位
用户可以立即看到房产所在位置以及周边地区的情况。

更好地了解位置
尤其是在慕尼黑或伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷等地区，微观位置往往至关重要。地图视图可帮助用户更好地真实评估距离、基础设施和周围环境。

聚焦相关区域物业
该应用程序不是成千上万的随机列表，而是专注于来自区域专业房地产机构的精选房产。

更轻松地比较不同位置
用户可以直接识别住宅区的不同之处，例如慕尼黑市区和周边较安静的城镇之间的差异。

减少在不合适的列表上浪费的时间
许多用户首先根据位置进行选择。视觉搜索使这一步变得更快。

直接联系当地专家
感兴趣的用户可以轻松发送询问或安排看房，而无需在多个平台之间切换。

更畅快的移动体验
搜索感觉更直观，因为用户可以浏览地图并主动探索不同的区域。

该应用程序的设计目的不是让房产搜索变得更加复杂，而是更容易理解——明确关注位置、区域专业知识，以及更轻松地浏览慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷周围的房地产市场。

plugin_asdk_app_6a16c49819348191a9f8924e.productIntro: ProEigentum Immobilien 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于大慕尼黑地区，提供直观、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a16c49819348191a9f8924e.productIntroEn: ProEigentum Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the greater Munich area and offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties.
plugin_asdk_app_6a16c49819348191a9f8924e.longDescription:
ProEigentum Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the greater Munich area and offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties.

Instead of browsing through long and confusing property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it immediately clear where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like — creating a faster, more transparent, and more enjoyable property search experience.

With a clear focus on Munich and the surrounding regions, ProEigentum Immobilien combines local market expertise with modern digital solutions to make property searching simpler and more efficient.

Advantages at a Glance
Interactive property search with a modern map view
Faster orientation within Munich and surrounding areas
Better understanding of micro-locations and infrastructure
Focus on selected properties in the greater Munich region
Easier comparison of different residential areas
Time savings through visual location-based searching
Direct contact with regional real estate experts
Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether it’s a city apartment in Munich, a family home in the suburbs, or an attractive investment property — ProEigentum Immobilien provides a modern and transparent gateway to the real estate market in the greater Munich area.
plugin_asdk_app_6a16c49819348191a9f8924e.longDescriptionZh:
ProEigentum Immobilien 是一家现代化房地产公司，专注于大慕尼黑地区，提供直观、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售房产。

用户无需浏览冗长且令人困惑的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓和投资房产。这使得您可以立即清楚房产所在的位置以及周边地区的情况，从而创造更快、更透明、更愉快的房产搜索体验。

ProEigentum Immobilien 明确关注慕尼黑及周边地区，将当地市场专业知识与现代数字解决方案相结合，使房产搜索变得更简单、更高效。

优势一览
具有现代地图视图的交互式房产搜索
在慕尼黑及周边地区更快定位
更好地了解微观位置和基础设施
专注于大慕尼黑地区的精选房产
更容易比较不同住宅区
通过基于视觉位置的搜索节省时间
与区域房地产专家直接联系
现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论是慕尼黑的城市公寓、郊区的家庭住宅还是有吸引力的投资房产——ProEigentum Immobilien 都为进入大慕尼黑地区的房地产市场提供了现代化、透明的门户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a82756d9a248191b26fb193.longDescription: Ellie Vincy makes press-on nails from a mold of your own fingers, so they fit the shape of your natural nails instead of a generic size chart. This app explains that process end to end: order the Custom Nail Starter Pack, take a mold of all ten fingers at home, mail it back with a prepaid USPS QR code that needs no printer or stamp, follow the status timeline as it reaches the studio, and artisans then hand-build every set on your mold. Once your mold is on file, reorders skip the molding step entirely. The app also searches the live ellievincynails.com catalog by style, shape, length or nail-care item and returns matching products with current prices, stock status and direct links, read from the Shopify Storefront API in real time. It is read-only, shows physical goods only, and links out to the storefront for checkout.

plugin_asdk_app_6a3d5936cef08191856faa2c.longDescription:
Thomas Franck Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Schwerin and the surrounding region. The app offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in the capital of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and its neighboring areas.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to see the location, nearby infrastructure, and neighborhood at a glance, making the property search process simpler and more efficient.

With extensive local market expertise and personalized advice, Thomas Franck Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with many years of experience in the real estate market in Schwerin and the surrounding region.

Key Benefits
Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster orientation in Schwerin and the surrounding area
Better understanding of property locations, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different districts and municipalities
More efficient property search through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
Modern, user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a city apartment in Schwerin, a family home in the surrounding countryside, or an attractive investment opportunity, Thomas Franck Immobilien provides a modern, transparent, and convenient way to access the real estate market in Schwerin and the surrounding region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d5936cef08191856faa2c.longDescriptionZh:
Thomas Franck Immobilien 是一家专门从事什未林及周边地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚州首府及其周边地区的房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产。这使得位置、附近的基础设施和社区一目了然，使房产搜索过程更简单、更高效。

凭借丰富的本地市场专业知识和个性化建议，Thomas Franck Immobilien 将现代数字解决方案与什未林及周边地区房地产市场的多年经验相结合。

主要优点
使用基于地图的现代界面进行交互式财产搜索
在什未林及周边地区更快的定位
更好地了解房产位置、基础设施和社区
专注于该地区精心挑选的住宅和投资物业
更容易比较不同地区和城市
通过视觉导航更高效的房产搜索
与经验丰富的房地产专业人士直接联系
现代、用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在寻找什未林的城市公寓、周边乡村的家庭住宅，还是有吸引力的投资机会，Thomas Franck Immobilien 都能为您提供进入什未林及周边地区房地产市场的现代、透明且便捷的方式。

plugin_asdk_app_6a970dea8db08191acaf530c.name: Weather by WindBorne
plugin_asdk_app_6a970dea8db08191acaf530c.productIntro: WindBorne 可让您利用世界上最大的气象气球群的数据来提供更好的天气预报。每个气球都会从传统观测方法无法覆盖的地区收集关键的现场数据，为国家气象局 (NWS)、NOAA 和其他气象机构提供观测数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a970dea8db08191acaf530c.productIntroEn: WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.
plugin_asdk_app_6a970dea8db08191acaf530c.longDescription:
WindBorne lets you harness data from the largest constellation of weather balloons in the world, for a better weather forecast. Each balloon collects critical in-situ data from regions beyond the reach of traditional observation methods, supplying observations to the National Weather Service (NWS), NOAA, and other meteorological agencies.

Ask your agent about the weather and get personalized insights powered by WeatherMesh, WindBorne's world-leading weather forecasting model, AI-based or otherwise.

Get a complete forecast at a glance, explore one variable in depth, or compare conditions across multiple locations. Find the best weather window for a run, flight, or the trip you have yet to plan - or watch storms, fronts, wind, and precipitation unfold on a map.
plugin_asdk_app_6a970dea8db08191acaf530c.longDescriptionZh:
WindBorne 可让您利用世界上最大的气象气球群的数据来提供更好的天气预报。每个气球都会从传统观测方法无法覆盖的地区收集关键的现场数据，为国家气象局 (NWS)、NOAA 和其他气象机构提供观测数据。

向您的代理询问天气情况，并获得由 WeatherMesh（WindBorne 世界领先的基于人工智能或其他方式的天气预报模型）提供支持的个性化见解。

一目了然地获得完整的预测，深入探索一个变量，或比较多个地点的情况。找到适合跑步、飞行或尚未计划的旅行的最佳天气窗口，或者在地图上观看风暴、锋面、风和降水的情况。
defaultPrompts: I want to hike Mount Shasta this week . When should I go?
I'm planning a weekend trip with friends. Can you compare the weather in Denver, New York, and LA?
Show me the heatwave affecting Europe next week.

plugin_asdk_app_6a99c5aad8888191bd2b819e.description: 通过聊天可扩展的食谱
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c5aad8888191bd2b819e.productIntro: Cook and Scale 是一个菜谱网站，其中每个菜谱都会根据您需要的份数进行清晰地缩放，并按照厨师实际测量的方式编写数量。该连接器可让您通过对话构建菜谱集合。听写你祖母的烤宽面条，一起制定工作日晚上的晚餐，或者交出你一直在读的食谱——它会作为真实的、结构化的食谱出现在你的 Cook and Scale 帐户中：配料与食物数据库相匹配，因此数量可以适当调整，步骤与计时器、准备和烹饪时间、菜肴、膳食类型、饮食和设备。
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c5aad8888191bd2b819e.productIntroEn: Cook and Scale is a recipe site where every recipe scales cleanly to the number of servings you need, with amounts written the way a cook actually measures them. This connector lets you build your recipe collection by conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c5aad8888191bd2b819e.longDescription: Cook and Scale is a recipe site where every recipe scales cleanly to the number of servings you need, with amounts written the way a cook actually measures them. This connector lets you build your recipe collection by conversation. Dictate your grandmother's lasagne, work out a weeknight dinner together, or hand over a recipe you have been reading — and it lands in your Cook and Scale account as a real, structured recipe: ingredients matched to a food database so quantities scale properly, steps with timers, prep and cook times, cuisine, meal type, diets and equipment. Recipes can be written in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish or Portuguese, and one recipe can hold several languages at once. You can also read your recipes back, correct them, add a photograph of your own, or have an illustrative photo generated when you do not have one. Beyond the recipes themselves, the assistant can keep your pantry (what you have in, and how much), find recipes you can cook from it and deduct what a meal used, plan your week, save recipes to your book and sort them into collections. Everything an assistant adds arrives privately in your Recipe inbox, where you review it. Nothing is ever published to the public site by an assistant — that stays your own action, taken on the website. You choose which of seven permissions to grant when you connect, and you can change or revoke them at any time in your settings.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c5aad8888191bd2b819e.longDescriptionZh: Cook and Scale 是一个菜谱网站，其中每个菜谱都会根据您需要的份数进行清晰地缩放，并按照厨师实际测量的方式编写数量。该连接器可让您通过对话构建菜谱集合。听写你祖母的烤宽面条，一起制定工作日晚上的晚餐，或者交出你一直在读的食谱——它会作为真实的、结构化的食谱出现在你的 Cook and Scale 帐户中：配料与食物数据库相匹配，因此数量可以适当调整，步骤与计时器、准备和烹饪时间、菜肴、膳食类型、饮食和设备。食谱可以用英语、德语、法语、意大利语、西班牙语或葡萄牙语编写，一个食谱可以同时包含多种语言。您还可以读回您的食谱，进行更正，添加您自己的照片，或者在您没有照片时生成一张说明性照片。除了食谱本身之外，助手还可以保存你的食品储藏室（你有什么，有多少），找到你可以烹饪的食谱，并扣除一顿饭的用量，计划你的一周，将食谱保存到你的书中，并将它们分类到收藏中。助理添加的所有内容都会私下到达您的食谱收件箱，您可以在其中查看。助手不会将任何内容发布到公共网站上——这仍然是您自己在网站上采取的行动。您可以选择在连接时授予七个权限中的哪一个，并且可以随时在设置中更改或撤销它们。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58989aa081919f4658ff.name: ShotPulled
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58989aa081919f4658ff.productIntro: 调入更好的浓缩咖啡，一次进行一种明智的调整。 设置一次咖啡豆、研磨机、浓缩咖啡机和秤。每次拍摄后，记录剂量、产量、冲泡时间以及味道。 ShotPulled 会考虑完整的环境，包括咖啡的陈年时间和研磨机的校准方式，然后为您的下一次冲泡推荐最有用的调整，并解释原因。 ShotPulled 还可自动保持您的咖啡库存准确。每个记录的剂量都会从袋子中扣除，因此您可以看到剩余的克数，并根据您实际使用的剂量估计剩余的注射次数。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58989aa081919f4658ff.productIntroEn: Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time. Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58989aa081919f4658ff.longDescription:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c58989aa081919f4658ff.longDescriptionZh:
调入更好的浓缩咖啡，一次进行一种明智的调整。
设置一次咖啡豆、研磨机、浓缩咖啡机和秤。每次拍摄后，记录剂量、产量、冲泡时间以及味道。 ShotPulled 会考虑完整的环境，包括咖啡的陈年时间和研磨机的校准方式，然后为您的下一次冲泡推荐最有用的调整，并解释原因。
ShotPulled 还可自动保持您的咖啡库存准确。每个记录的剂量都会从袋子中扣除，因此您可以看到剩余的克数，并根据您实际使用的剂量估计剩余的注射次数。它还跟踪包的高峰窗口，显示剩余的高峰天数以及窗口结束的日期。
当食谱有效时，将其锁定并随时返回。 ShotPulled 支持跨点击、编号环、复合环位置（例如 1.2.2）和命名设置的研磨机设置，具有适用于 67 台研磨机、124 台浓缩咖啡机和 24 台秤的内置规格。
您的 ShotPulled 帐户在 ChatGPT、Web 仪表板和 iPhone 应用程序之间保持同步。在这里注册一个包，当您准备好拍摄下一张照片时，它已经在您的手机上等待了。

Astrotheoros links your saved chart library to the assistant. Once you sign in, it can look up any chart in your account, calculate transits, progressions, returns, synastry, and composites against those charts, and read or write the notes attached to them, all with the settings you already use in the app. It can also lookup Zodiacal Releasing or Vimshottari Dasha periods and organize your charts into folders.

Ask in plain language. "What are my transits this week?" "Compare my chart with Sam's." "Which zodiacal releasing period am I in right now?" "Add a note to Maria's chart about today's session." The assistant returns the same output as the app's copy button, so the numbers match what you see on screen, and you never have to type birth data into a chat.

The assistant works only with charts already in your account. It cannot create, edit, or delete charts, and it cannot change your settings. Requires an Astrotheoros account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a1581890a0c8191bd08bd4b.name: Kostner Immobilien
plugin_asdk_app_6a1581890a0c8191bd08bd4b.productIntro: Kostner Immobilien 是一家专门从事维也纳及周边地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或租赁奥地利首都及附近地区的房产。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1581890a0c8191bd08bd4b.productIntroEn: Kostner Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Vienna and the surrounding areas. The app offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or rent properties in Austria’s capital city and nearby regions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1581890a0c8191bd08bd4b.longDescription:
Kostner Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in Vienna and the surrounding areas. The app offers an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or rent properties in Austria’s capital city and nearby regions.

Instead of browsing through endless property listings, users can explore available apartments, houses, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes the search process clearer, more efficient, and far more realistic, as the location and surrounding environment are immediately visible.

With deep market knowledge of Vienna and neighboring regions, Kostner Immobilien combines personalized consulting with modern digital solutions for a contemporary real estate search experience.

Advantages at a Glance
* Interactive property search with a modern map view
* Faster orientation in Vienna and surrounding areas
* Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and neighborhood environment
* Focus on selected properties in attractive residential locations
* Easier comparison of different districts and regions
* More efficient searching through visual navigation
* Direct contact with regional real estate experts
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether it’s a stylish historic apartment in Vienna, a family home in the suburbs, or an attractive investment property, Kostner Immobilien provides a modern and transparent approach to the real estate market in Vienna and the surrounding areas.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1581890a0c8191bd08bd4b.longDescriptionZh:
Kostner Immobilien 是一家专门从事维也纳及周边地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或租赁奥地利首都及附近地区的房产。

用户无需浏览无休止的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的公寓、房屋和投资房产。这使得搜索过程更清晰、更高效、更真实，因为位置和周围环境立即可见。

凭借对维也纳及周边地区的深入市场了解，Kostner Immobilien 将个性化咨询与现代数字解决方案相结合，打造当代房地产搜索体验。

优势一览
* 具有现代地图视图的交互式房产搜索
* 维也纳及周边地区更快的定位
* 更好地了解位置、基础设施和邻里环境
* 专注于有吸引力的住宅区的精选房产
* 更容易比较不同地区和地区
* 通过视觉导航更高效的搜索
* 与区域房地产专家直接联系
* 现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论是维也纳时尚的历史公寓、郊区的家庭住宅还是有吸引力的投资房产，Kostner Immobilien 都为维也纳及周边地区的房地产市场提供了现代、透明的方法。
defaultPrompts: Properties in Wien
defaultPromptsZh: 维也纳房产

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ec981a5708191af9a9404.productIntroEn: Search live property listings across Iraq — apartments, houses, villas, land, offices and shops — for sale or rent in Erbil, Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok, Kirkuk and other cities.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ec981a5708191af9a9404.longDescription:
Search live property listings across Iraq — apartments, houses, villas, land, offices and shops — for sale or rent in Erbil, Baghdad, Sulaymaniyah, Duhok, Kirkuk and other cities.

Filter by city, neighborhood, price, bedrooms, bathrooms and rental frequency. Results come back as visual cards showing the photo, price, size and listing agency, and every card links straight to the full listing on homele.com.

You can also browse new development projects, look up agencies by city, and open interactive land-plot maps for areas that have them.

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d69ec9ef88191a93ff7e1.productIntro: SaltyBytes 从网络上查找真实的、已发布的食谱，并将它们带入您的聊天中，然后将您喜欢的食谱保存到您自己的 SaltyBytes 收藏中，以便您做饭时在应用程序中准备好它们。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d69ec9ef88191a93ff7e1.productIntroEn: SaltyBytes finds real, published recipes from across the web and brings them into your chat, then saves the ones you like to your own SaltyBytes collection so they are ready in the app when you cook.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d69ec9ef88191a93ff7e1.longDescription:
SaltyBytes finds real, published recipes from across the web and brings them into your chat, then saves the ones you like to your own SaltyBytes collection so they are ready in the app when you cook.

Ask for something specific, like a gluten-free birthday cake or a 30-minute weeknight salmon, and SaltyBytes searches the open web and returns real recipes with full ingredients, steps, and times, so you can decide before you commit. Paste a recipe link and it extracts the recipe cleanly. Say the word and it saves the recipe to your collection, where it syncs with the SaltyBytes mobile app. You can also look up the recipes you have already saved, all without leaving the conversation.

SaltyBytes only reads and writes your own recipe collection, through a scoped connection you approve and can revoke at any time. A free SaltyBytes account is required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d69ec9ef88191a93ff7e1.longDescriptionZh:
SaltyBytes 从网络上查找真实的、已发布的食谱，并将它们带入您的聊天中，然后将您喜欢的食谱保存到您自己的 SaltyBytes 收藏中，以便您做饭时在应用程序中准备好它们。

SaltyBytes 仅通过您批准并可以随时撤销的范围连接来读取和写入您自己的配方集合。需要一个免费的 SaltyBytes 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4a5a256fa08191b1820f94.productIntro: BioStacks 根据真正重要的因素对补充剂进行评分：成分是否按瓶内剂量发挥作用。搜索或命名任何产品，并根据已发表的研究获得 0-100 的功效评分。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4a5a256fa08191b1820f94.productIntroEn: BioStacks scores supplements on what actually matters: whether the ingredients work at the doses inside the bottle. Search or name any product and get a 0–100 efficacy score grounded in published research.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4a5a256fa08191b1820f94.longDescription:
BioStacks scores supplements on what actually matters: whether the ingredients work at the doses inside the bottle. Search or name any product and get a 0–100 efficacy score grounded in published research.

For each product you see every active ingredient's dose measured against its clinically studied range, its form and bioavailability, safety flags on additives, and the health goals it genuinely supports. When a product is under dosed or built on weak evidence, BioStacks says so plainly.

Every ingredient links to an independent reference (Examine.com, NIH)  so you can check the science yourself, plus where to buy.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4a5a256fa08191b1820f94.longDescriptionZh:
BioStacks 根据真正重要的因素对补充剂进行评分：成分是否按瓶内剂量发挥作用。搜索或命名任何产品，并根据已发表的研究获得 0-100 的功效评分。

对于每种产品，您都会看到每种活性成分的剂量根据其临床研究范围、其形式和生物利用度、添加剂的安全标志以及其真正支持的健康目标进行测量。当产品剂量不足或证据不足时，BioStacks 会明确表示。

每种成分都链接到独立参考文献（Examine.com、NIH），因此您可以自己检查科学原理以及购买地点。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5c96002bc8819187400b66.productIntro: AllDiscGolf 找到所有圆盘高尔夫球盘的最优惠价格。索要一张光盘，即可在欧洲和美国 100 多家专业零售商处获得最便宜的当前报价，并提供每个报价的塑料材质、重量和状况。按技能水平和航班获取光盘推荐，以 0-10 的条件等级浏览二手光盘市场，并了解经过验证的降价 — 相对于稳定价格的真实降价，而不是虚假的删除折扣。每个结果都会链接到零售商自己的产品页面以完成购买； AllDiscGolf 会比较价格，并且自己从不销售任何东西。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c96002bc8819187400b66.productIntroEn: AllDiscGolf finds the best price for any disc golf disc. Ask for a disc and get the cheapest current offers across 100+ specialist retailers in Europe and the US, with plastic, weight and condition for every offer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c96002bc8819187400b66.longDescription: AllDiscGolf finds the best price for any disc golf disc. Ask for a disc and get the cheapest current offers across 100+ specialist retailers in Europe and the US, with plastic, weight and condition for every offer. Get disc recommendations by skill level and flight, browse the used-disc marketplace with a 0–10 condition scale, and catch verified price drops — real drops against stable prices, not fake strike-through discounts. Every result links to the retailer's own product page to complete the purchase; AllDiscGolf compares prices and never sells anything itself.

plugin_asdk_app_6a74c64e611081919a3c0b2e.longDescription:
Bring VANA a goal, a podcast, a training plan, and turn it into something you can actually follow. Then run it, check in, make changes, and learn what works for you

With VANA you can: 
• Turn ideas, goals, and expert advice into practical protocols 
• Personalize a protocol around your routine 
• Adjust the plan when life or your recovery changes
• Review your progress, patterns, and adherence over time
plugin_asdk_app_6a74c64e611081919a3c0b2e.longDescriptionZh:

通过 VANA，您可以： 
• 将想法、目标和专家建议转化为实用的方案 
• 根据您的日常习惯制定个性化方案 
• 当生活或您的康复情况发生变化时调整计划
• 回顾您一段时间内的进展、模式和坚持情况

plugin_asdk_app_6a9c261165988191ade86cf6.name: PeriodFinder
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c261165988191ade86cf6.productIntro: periodFinder 将每个品牌发布的尺码和吸收性声明放在一个标度上，以便进行实际比较。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c261165988191ade86cf6.productIntroEn: PeriodFinder puts every brand's published sizing and absorbency claims on one scale, so they can actually be compared.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c261165988191ade86cf6.longDescription:
PeriodFinder puts every brand's published sizing and absorbency claims on one scale, so they can actually be compared.

Absorbency is translated into millilitres and graded by how well each brand documents its number. Sizing is translated from a single hip measurement into each brand's own size, with notes where a brand runs small or large.

Ask which Knix tier matches Thinx Super, what size fits a 40 inch hip in every brand, or which in-stock products cover a given absorbency. Answers come from a catalog of 468 products across nine brands, refreshed weekly, with the method published openly at periodfinder.com/absorbency/methodology.

PeriodFinder is an independent comparison site. It is not medical advice, it does not diagnose anything, and it takes no payment from any brand for placement or ranking.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9c261165988191ade86cf6.longDescriptionZh:
periodFinder 将每个品牌发布的尺码和吸收性声明放在一个标度上，以便进行实际比较。

吸收率被转换为毫升，并根据每个品牌记录其数字的程度进行分级。尺码从单个臀围测量值转换为每个品牌自己的尺码，并注明品牌尺码偏小或偏大。

询问 Knix 的哪个层与 Thinx Super 相匹配，每个品牌的 40 英寸臀部适合什么尺寸，或者哪些库存产品涵盖给定的吸收能力。答案来自九个品牌的 468 种产品目录，每周更新一次，方法在 periodfinder.com/absorbency/methodology 上公开发布。

periodFinder 是一个独立的比较网站。它不是医疗建议，它不诊断任何东西，并且不向任何品牌收取任何费用来进行排名或排名。
defaultPrompts: What Knix tier matches Thinx Super?
What size fits a 40 inch hip in every brand?
Which period underwear holds at least 30 ml and is in stock under $30?
defaultPromptsZh: 哪个 Knix 级别与 Thinx Super 相匹配？
各个品牌的 40 英寸臀围适合什么尺寸？
哪种经期内衣的容量至少为 30 毫升，且库存低于 30 美元？

iscabox is Brazil's sport-fishing assistant. This plugin gives ChatGPT the same catalog our own assistant uses: 1,300+ fishing spots in every Brazilian state (searchable by name, city or proximity), 170 species guides, recommended lures per species, techniques, traced river courses, tide tables with moon phase and solunar windows for 35 ports, and hundreds of reels, rods, lines and lures with today's price on Amazon, Mercado Livre, AliExpress and Shopee.

Ask the way you would ask another angler, in Portuguese: "onde pescar tucunaré no Amazonas?", "que isca usar para traíra em pesqueiro?", "maré em Salvador hoje", "carretilha perfil baixo até R$ 500", "monte uma tralha para robalo com 800 reais".

Every answer comes only from the catalog (no invented prices, models or places) and links to the iscabox page with photo, current price and where to buy. Free, no account needed.

plugin_asdk_app_694b80dbf6388191898e3552.name: eesel Shopping Assistant
plugin_asdk_app_694b80dbf6388191898e3552.productIntro: 网上购物感觉就像是一场你注定会失败的信任练习。你发现一款产品有 5,000 条五星级评论，但其中一半看起来像机器人，另一半则是人们只是因为盒子准时到达而感到高兴。不可能知道什么是真正好的。
plugin_asdk_app_694b80dbf6388191898e3552.productIntroEn: Shopping online feels like a trust exercise you're destined to fail. You find a product with 5,000 five-star reviews, but half of them look like bots and the other half are people just happy the box arrived on time. It's impossible to know what's actually good.
plugin_asdk_app_694b80dbf6388191898e3552.longDescription:
Shopping online feels like a trust exercise you're destined to fail. You find a product with 5,000 five-star reviews, but half of them look like bots and the other half are people just happy the box arrived on time. It's impossible to know what's actually good.

This app cuts through the junk. You tell us what you need, and we ignore the sponsored placements to build you a shortlist based on merit, not marketing budget.

This is where we do the heavy lifting. We don't just show you the star rating; we dig into the text to find the truth. We scan forum discussions, Reddit threads, and verified purchase comments to summarize the actual consensus.

- The Good: We highlight the specific features real people love.
- The Bad: We spot the patterns in the complaints - like if a "waterproof" boot actually leaks after a month.
- The Verdict: We tell you if the hype is real or if you should keep looking.

Once you have a few options, we stack them side-by-side. You get a clean look at the specs and prices without opening twenty tabs or building your own spreadsheet. It's the deep research you want to do, done for you in seconds.
plugin_asdk_app_694b80dbf6388191898e3552.longDescriptionZh:
网上购物感觉就像是一场你注定会失败的信任练习。你发现一款产品有 5,000 条五星级评论，但其中一半看起来像机器人，另一半则是人们只是因为盒子准时到达而感到高兴。不可能知道什么是真正好的。

这个应用程序可以清除垃圾。您告诉我们您的需求，我们会忽略赞助广告位，根据绩效而不是营销预算为您构建候选名单。

这是我们进行繁重工作的地方。我们不只是向您展示星级；我们还向您展示星级。我们深入研究文本以寻找真相。我们扫描论坛讨论、Reddit 帖子和经过验证的购买评论，以总结实际的共识。

- 优点：我们突出了人们喜爱的具体功能。
- 缺点：我们在投诉中发现了一些模式 - 例如“防水”靴子在一个月后实际上是否漏水。
- 结论：我们会告诉您炒作是否真实，或者您是否应该继续寻找。

一旦您有了一些选择，我们就会将它们并排堆叠。您无需打开二十个选项卡或构建自己的电子表格，即可清楚地了解规格和​​价格。这是您想要进行的深入研究，只需几秒钟即可完成。
defaultPrompts: Help me buy a MacBook
defaultPromptsZh: 帮我买一台MacBook

plugin_asdk_app_6a7a17e926288191901f3ece.productIntro: AllNutrition — 循证营养与长寿研究
plugin_asdk_app_6a7a17e926288191901f3ece.longDescription:
AllNutrition — Evidence-Based Nutrition & Longevity Research

Get clear, cited answers grounded in peer-reviewed nutrition, health, and longevity research. AllNutrition.info distills tens of thousands of scientific studies into practical, understandable insights—without industry-sponsored research or manufactured controversy.

Ask AllNutrition about nutrition, supplements, diet, metabolism, healthy aging, longevity, disease prevention, sports and exercise nutrition, and other evidence-based health topics. Get research-backed summaries, study citations, comparisons, and explanations of what the scientific evidence actually shows.

Use AllNutrition to:

- Find and understand peer-reviewed nutrition research
- Evaluate claims about foods, diets, supplements, and nutrients
- Explore longevity and healthy-aging research
- Compare competing nutrition claims and interventions
- Separate strong evidence from weak or uncertain findings
- Get concise answers with supporting scientific citations

Ask a question in plain English and AllNutrition turns the relevant research into a clear, evidence-focused answer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7a17e926288191901f3ece.longDescriptionZh:
AllNutrition — 循证营养与长寿研究

获得基于同行评审的营养、健康和长寿研究的清晰、引用的答案。 AllNutrition.info 将数以万计的科学研究提炼成实用的、易于理解的见解——没有行业赞助的研究或制造争议。

向 AllNutrition 询问营养、补充剂、饮食、新陈代谢、健康老龄化、长寿、疾病预防、运动和运动营养以及其他循证健康主题。获取研究支持的摘要、研究引文、比较以及科学证据实际显示内容的解释。

使用 AllNutrition 可以：

- 查找并了解同行评审的营养研究
- 评估有关食品、饮食、补充剂和营养素的声明
- 探索长寿和健康老龄化研究
- 比较相互竞争的营养声称和干预措施
- 将强有力的证据与薄弱或不确定的发现分开
- 通过支持科学引文获得简洁的答案

用简单的英语提出问题，AllNutrition 会将相关研究转化为清晰、注重证据的答案。
defaultPrompts: Is creatine safe and effective for healthy adults? Include evidence strength, scientific consensus, and key citations.

defaultPromptsZh: 肌酸对健康成年人安全有效吗？包括证据强度、科学共识和关键引文。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3c5e7fbc8191b5996fd2.productIntro: EasyRegistry 为婚礼、迎婴派对、生日和其他特殊场合提供在线礼品登记。无需登录，用户就可以搜索活动日期前后的公共注册表、查看某个注册表的公共详细信息以及浏览其可用的礼物。使用 OAuth 登录后，注册表所有者可以列出其注册表，查看礼物、捐款和总计，通过描述或粘贴产品链接来添加礼物，更新或删除礼物，以及更改注册表设置，例如标题、活动日期和位置。每个所有者工具都仅限于登录用户拥有的注册表。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3c5e7fbc8191b5996fd2.productIntroEn: EasyRegistry hosts online gift registries for weddings, baby showers, birthdays and other special occasions. Without signing in, users can search public registries around an event date, view one registry's public details, and browse its available gifts.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3c5e7fbc8191b5996fd2.longDescription: EasyRegistry hosts online gift registries for weddings, baby showers, birthdays and other special occasions. Without signing in, users can search public registries around an event date, view one registry's public details, and browse its available gifts. After signing in with OAuth, registry owners can list their registries, review gifts, contributions and totals, add a gift by describing it or by pasting a product link, update or remove a gift, and change registry settings such as the title, event date and location. Every owner tool is limited to registries the signed-in user owns. No tool moves money, refunds a payment or releases a payout, and contribution data is returned in a reduced, redacted form.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b3c5e7fbc8191b5996fd2.longDescriptionZh: EasyRegistry 为婚礼、迎婴派对、生日和其他特殊场合提供在线礼品登记。无需登录，用户就可以搜索活动日期前后的公共注册表、查看某个注册表的公共详细信息以及浏览其可用的礼物。使用 OAuth 登录后，注册表所有者可以列出其注册表，查看礼物、捐款和总计，通过描述或粘贴产品链接来添加礼物，更新或删除礼物，以及更改注册表设置，例如标题、活动日期和位置。每个所有者工具都仅限于登录用户拥有的注册表。没有任何工具可以转移资金、退款或发放支出，并且捐款数据会以简化的、经过编辑的形式返回。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9fa51824fc8191bf369895.productIntro: TheShop.mu 在毛里求斯各地配送杂货。连接 TheShop 帐户一次后，用户可以搜索目录、比较包含增值税的价格、保持购物车最新状态、检查过去的订单和付款状态、查看哪些送货详细信息将被重复使用，以及在 theshop.mu 上设置的支出限额内下订单。每个订单均由客户在安全的支付页面上支付；助理从不处理卡的详细信息。可以随时从客户的帐户页面撤销访问权限。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fa51824fc8191bf369895.productIntroEn: TheShop.mu delivers groceries across Mauritius. After connecting their TheShop account once, users can search the catalogue, compare prices with VAT included, keep their cart up to date, check past orders and payment status, see which delivery details would be reused, and place orders within the spending limits they set on theshop.mu.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fa51824fc8191bf369895.longDescription: TheShop.mu delivers groceries across Mauritius. plugin_asdk_app_6ab1548cdba481919c512e9a.longDescription: PawsRx helps pet owners across the United States find a vet, book one, and get a question answered by one. Search 26,000+ practices by location and by the animal, including dogs, cats, and exotics like rabbits, birds, reptiles, ferrets and guinea pigs, with the hours, species treated and prices each practice publishes, real appointment availability where the practice keeps its calendar online, and the ability to request an appointment. With Ask a Vet, send a question in your own words to the independent veterinarians who answer on PawsRx; a veterinarian writes the answer and it is emailed to you. Use PawsRx to find a vet, animal hospital, rabbit vet, exotic-animal vet or emergency vet, to check whether a practice sees a particular animal, is open at a given time or takes new patients, to see what vet care or grooming costs, or to ask a vet a question. Results are matches to what you asked for, not paid rankings. PawsRx is not a veterinary provider: the veterinarians are independent, answers come from them, and PawsRx itself never diagnoses or gives medical advice. In an emergency, go to an emergency veterinary hospital.

plugin_asdk_app_6a90fbfaa87081919b601305.description: 管理 Whatnot 突袭列车
plugin_asdk_app_6a90fbfaa87081919b601305.productIntro: RaidTrainExpress 将您的 RTE 突袭列车时刻表连接到 ChatGPT，这样您就可以在不离开对话的情况下查看即将发生的事情并设置下一个活动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a90fbfaa87081919b601305.productIntroEn: RaidTrainExpress connects your RTE raid train schedule to ChatGPT, so you can check what's coming up and set up your next event without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a90fbfaa87081919b601305.longDescription:
RaidTrainExpress connects your RTE raid train schedule to ChatGPT, so you can check what's coming up and set up your next event without leaving the conversation.

Ask what's on your calendar and get your trains, challenges, your own slot times, and any to-dos that are due — all in your timezone, with links back to each event. Ask about a specific train and you get what matters for your role: organizers see how much of the lineup is filled and who still has to-dos outstanding; participants see their slot and what they need to do before it.

Not sure how something works? Ask, and you get an answer drawn from the actual Raid Train Express help docs, with a link to the full article — no guessing about features.

When you're ready to run something new, it walks you through creating a train or a challenge one question at a time, checks your invite list against your contacts, and shows you the full plan before anything is created. Nothing goes live until you confirm.

Read-only unless you say otherwise, and it only ever sees what your own account can see. Connect and disconnect any time from your account settings.
plugin_asdk_app_6a90fbfaa87081919b601305.longDescriptionZh:
RaidTrainExpress 将您的 RTE 突袭列车时刻表连接到 ChatGPT，这样您就可以在不离开对话的情况下查看即将发生的事情并设置下一个活动。

询问您的日历上有什么，并获取您的火车、挑战、您自己的时段以及任何到期的待办事项 - 所有这些都在您的时区中，并提供返回每个活动的链接。询问特定的火车，您就会得到对您的角色重要的信息：组织者可以看到队列中有多少人已满，以及谁还有待办事项；参与者可以看到自己的时间段以及在此之前他们需要做什么。

不确定某些东西是如何工作的？询问后，您会得到来自实际 Raid Train Express 帮助文档的答案，其中包含完整文章的链接 - 无需猜测功能。

当您准备好运行新内容时，它会引导您一次一个问题地创建火车或挑战，根据您的联系人检查您的邀请列表，并在创建任何内容之前向您显示完整的计划。在您确认之前，一切都不会生效。

除非您另有说明，否则是只读的，并且它只能看到您自己的帐户可以看到的内容。随时通过您的帐户设置进行连接和断开连接。
