plugin_asdk_app_6aa16bce1f9c8191aa09005f.productIntro: 使用 Greenzone Engineering 计算引擎计算种植室 HVAC 冷却、除湿、气流和再加热要求。 ChatGPT 可以收集房间、照明、环境、冷却盘管和系统输入，将它们提交给计算器，并解释返回的结果。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa16bce1f9c8191aa09005f.productIntroEn: Calculate grow-room HVAC cooling, dehumidification, airflow, and reheat requirements using the Greenzone Engineering calculation engine. ChatGPT can collect room, lighting, environmental, cooling-coil, and system inputs, submit them to the calculator, and explain the returned results.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa16bce1f9c8191aa09005f.longDescription:
Calculate grow-room HVAC cooling, dehumidification, airflow, and reheat requirements using the Greenzone Engineering calculation engine. ChatGPT can collect room, lighting, environmental, cooling-coil, and system inputs, submit them to the calculator, and explain the returned results.  

The calculator supports Imperial/US and metric units, integrated and decoupled system configurations, rule-of-thumb comparisons, and analysis using selected actual airflow rates. Results are preliminary engineering estimates and should be reviewed by a qualified professional before final equipment selection or system design.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa16bce1f9c8191aa09005f.longDescriptionZh:
使用 Greenzone Engineering 计算引擎计算种植室 HVAC 冷却、除湿、气流和再加热要求。 ChatGPT 可以收集房间、照明、环境、冷却盘管和系统输入，将它们提交给计算器，并解释返回的结果。  

该计算器支持英制/美制和公制单位、集成和解耦系统配置、经验法则比较以及使用选定的实际气流速率进行分析。结果是初步的工程估计，应在最终设备选择或系统设计之前由合格的专业人员进行审查。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3105a9510c8191a65eb7e2.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 内搜索 Gmarket，韩国最大的在线市场之一。按照您通常的方式询问，例如“推荐给我女朋友的生日礼物”、“30,000 韩元以下的无线鼠标”或“iPhone 16 保护壳”，然后在可滑动卡片视图中比较匹配的产品与图像、价格、折扣、星级、评论数、卖家和运输详细信息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3105a9510c8191a65eb7e2.productIntroEn: Search Gmarket, one of Korea's largest online marketplaces, right inside ChatGPT. Ask the way you normally would, such as "recommend a birthday gift for my girlfriend", "a wireless mouse under 30,000 won", or "iPhone 16 case", and compare the matching products in a swipeable card view with images, prices, discounts, star ratings, review counts, seller, and shipping details.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3105a9510c8191a65eb7e2.longDescription:
Search Gmarket, one of Korea's largest online marketplaces, right inside ChatGPT. Ask the way you normally would, such as "recommend a birthday gift for my girlfriend", "a wireless mouse under 30,000 won", or "iPhone 16 case", and compare the matching products in a swipeable card view with images, prices, discounts, star ratings, review counts, seller, and shipping details.

Refine as you chat. Search again with more specific keywords, set a price range, or ask to compare a few alternatives and get a separate set of results for each. Each search shows up to 10 products, and the "전체보기" (View all) link on the cards takes you to the full results on Gmarket. When you find the right one, tap the card to complete your purchase on Gmarket.

Gmarket offers a wide selection across fashion, beauty, home appliances, electronics, groceries, home & living, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3105a9510c8191a65eb7e2.longDescriptionZh:

边聊天边细化。使用更具体的关键字再次搜索，设置价格范围，或要求比较几个替代方案并为每个替代方案获得一组单独的结果。每次搜索最多显示 10 个产品，卡片上的“전체보기”（查看全部）链接可带您访问 Gmarket 上的完整结果。找到合适的卡后，点击该卡即可在 Gmarket 上完成购买。

Gmarket 提供时尚、美容、家用电器、电子产品、杂货、家居和生活等领域的广泛选择。

plugin_asdk_app_69e0a46f020081919928a336.productIntro: OnStyle 是一款连接到韩国电视家庭购物平台的对话式购物应用程序，旨在在 ChatGPT 中发现时尚、美容、食品和其他生活方式类别的产品。用户可以根据风格、季节、预算或背景自然地描述他们想要的东西，并通过多个回合的后续细化获得相关的产品结果。 OnStyle还支持搜索广播产品，帮助用户以比传统关键字搜索更直观的方式探索购物选项。
plugin_asdk_app_69e0a46f020081919928a336.productIntroEn: OnStyle is a conversational shopping app connected to a Korean TV home-shopping platform, built for discovering products across fashion, beauty, food, and other lifestyle categories in ChatGPT. Users can describe what they want naturally — by style, season, budget, or context — and receive relevant product results with follow-up refinement across multiple turns.
plugin_asdk_app_69e0a46f020081919928a336.longDescription: OnStyle is a conversational shopping app connected to a Korean TV home-shopping platform, built for discovering products across fashion, beauty, food, and other lifestyle categories in ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_697ab8ecb004819180d0e574.productIntro: 活出你的新美丽，爱茉莉购物中心 아모레퍼시픽께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요。
plugin_asdk_app_697ab8ecb004819180d0e574.productIntroEn: LIVE YOUR NEW BEAUTY, AMORE MALL 아모레퍼시픽이 만든 라이프 뷰티 쇼핑몰, 아모레몰과 함께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요.
plugin_asdk_app_697ab8ecb004819180d0e574.longDescription:
LIVE YOUR NEW BEAUTY, AMORE MALL
아모레퍼시픽이 만든 라이프 뷰티 쇼핑몰, 아모레몰과 함께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요.

1. 아모레퍼시픽 브랜드 직영 쇼핑과 신뢰할 수 있는 배송
설화수, 헤라, 이니스프리, 에뛰드 등 아모레퍼시픽의 모든 브랜드를 가장 빠르게 만나보세요. 본사 직영 공식몰로서 100% 정품 보장은 물론, 신상품 단독 혜택과 안전한 직배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 본사가 직접 보증하는 신뢰도 높은 쇼핑 환경에서 안심하고 제품을 선택할 수 있습니다.

2. 풍성한 쇼핑 지원과 차별화된 멤버십 플러스
매월 업데이트되는 등급별 할인 쿠폰과 무료 배송/반품 서비스로 스마트한 소비를 도와드립니다. 특히 가입비 이상의 포인트 페이백과 프리미엄 사은품, 기프트카드를 제공하는 '멤버십플러스'를 통해 압도적인 체감 혜택을 누릴 수 있습니다. 활동할수록 높아지는 쇼핑 등급에 따라 제공되는 프리미엄 라운지 경품 등 다채로운 혜택을 경험해 보세요.

3. 스킨노트와 뷰티피드로 완성하는 맞춤형 피부 관리
단순한 구매를 넘어 개인화된 뷰티 루틴을 지원합니다. '스킨노트' 기능을 통해 매일의 피부 변화와 스킨케어 습관을 기록하고 관리할 수 있습니다. 또한, '뷰티피드'에서는 나와 같은 피부 고민을 가진 실사용자들의 진솔한 리뷰와 전문 에디터의 큐레이션 콘텐츠를 통해 나에게 꼭 맞는 최적의 솔루션을 발견할 수 있습니다.

4. 지속 가능한 뷰티를 위한 리사이클 캠페인
온라인으로 간편하게 참여하는 '아모레리사이클'을 통해 다 사용한 화장품 용기를 수거하고 플라스틱 재활용에 동참할 수 있습니다. 환경을 생각하는 작은 실천으로 나만의 디지털 숲을 가꾸며 건강한 뷰티 라이프를 완성해 보세요.

plugin_asdk_app_6948b40904d08191b61d4556.originalDescription: Find by style, pick by reviews
plugin_asdk_app_6948b40904d08191b61d4556.productIntro: 提出一种情况，它会为你显示一些物品——比如“明天的约会服装”、“工作裤”、“实际上很温暖的冬季羽绒服”或“舒适的运动鞋”。 当某样东西引起你的注意时，它会立即调出评论并总结关键信息——“尺码偏小还是偏大？”、“面料结实吗？”、“合身程度如何？”——因此比较选项很容易。 更少的滚动，更快的选择。
plugin_asdk_app_6948b40904d08191b61d4556.productIntroEn: Throw in a situation and it’ll surface items for you—like “tomorrow’s date outfit,” “work slacks,” “a winter puffer that’s actually warm,” or “comfy sneakers.” When something catches your eye, it pulls up the reviews right away and summarizes the key bits—“Does it run small or big?”, “Is the fabric sturdy?”, “How’s the fit?”—so comparing options is easy. Less scrolling, faster picks.

plugin_asdk_app_6a66b761ca9c81919602a1aa.name: ZAMA 中古バイク買取・原付買取・スクーター出張査定
plugin_asdk_app_6a66b761ca9c81919602a1aa.description: 我们购买摩托车和踏板车
plugin_asdk_app_6a66b761ca9c81919602a1aa.productIntro: 适合想要出售二手摩托车、轻便摩托车或踏板车的日本人。
plugin_asdk_app_6a66b761ca9c81919602a1aa.productIntroEn: For people in Japan who want to sell a used motorcycle, moped or scooter.
plugin_asdk_app_6a66b761ca9c81919602a1aa.longDescription:
For people in Japan who want to sell a used motorcycle, moped or scooter.

What this app does
- Model identification: from a loose description such as "the 150cc Honda PCX" or "a 50cc scooter I used to ride", it matches the vehicle against our dataset of 842 models. Models not in the dataset are directed to a phone consultation.
- Estimated buyback price by condition: an estimate in Japanese yen across five condition grades - like-new, running/very good, running/typical for its age, running with damage or faults, and non-running or accident-damaged.
- Request a free on-site appraisal: it submits the customer's name, phone number, area and model, then returns a reference number. The appointment is NOT fixed at that moment; our staff call back to agree the date. Up to three preferred times can be included (all optional).

Service area
Seven prefectures: Kanagawa, Tokyo, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki, Gunma and Yamanashi. The area widens as we add partner dealers. Travel, appraisal and cancellation are all free of charge.

Who carries out the appraisal
Every request is received by UsedBikeCenter ZAMA and we handle all first contact. Inside Kanagawa we visit and buy directly. In the other six prefectures we introduce a partner secondhand-goods dealer, and that partner carries out the on-site appraisal and the purchase; we act as the introducer and receive a referral fee. In those cases the request details - name, phone number, area, model, condition, preferred times and notes - are shared with that partner and used only to arrange and carry out the appraisal. This is stated in our privacy policy.

Before anything is sent
The tool first returns a preview of the request together with the sharing notice above. It transmits only after the customer has reviewed it and given explicit consent. Until then the tool returns the preview only.

No payments inside ChatGPT
This app only looks up price estimates and submits a request for a free appraisal. There is no payment, checkout, order or purchase of goods in ChatGPT. All figures are non-binding estimates; the final price is agreed after the vehicle is inspected in person. This is C2B - the shop buys from the customer and does not sell vehicles.

UsedBikeCenter ZAMA, Zama City, Kanagawa, Japan
Licensed secondhand goods dealer: Kanagawa Prefectural Public Safety Commission No. 452790009540
Phone: +81 50-3637-3699 (open daily, 9:00-21:00 JST)
plugin_asdk_app_6a66b761ca9c81919602a1aa.longDescriptionZh:
适合想要出售二手摩托车、轻便摩托车或踏板车的日本人。

这个应用程序的作用
- 型号识别：从宽松的描述（例如“150cc 本田 PCX”或“我曾经骑过的 50cc 踏板车”）中，将车辆与我们的 842 个型号的数据集进行匹配。数据集中没有的模型将直接进行电话咨询。
- 按状况估计的回购价格：按日元估算的五个状况等级 - 像新的、运行中/非常好、运行中/典型的使用年限、运行时有损坏或故障、非运行或事故损坏。
- 请求免费现场评估：提交客户姓名、电话号码、地区和型号，然后返回参考号。预约当时尚未确定；我们的工作人员回电以同意日期。最多可以包含三个首选时间（全部可选）。

服务区
七个县：神奈川县、东京都、埼玉县、千叶县、茨城县、群马县、山梨县。随着我们增加合作伙伴经销商，该领域不断扩大。旅行、评估和取消均免费。

由谁进行评估
二手自行车中心 ZAMA 会收到每个请求，我们会处理所有第一次联系。我们在神奈川县内参观并直接购买。在其他6个都道府县介绍二手货经销商合作伙伴，由该合作伙伴进行现场鉴定和购买；我们作为介绍人并收取推荐费。在这些情况下，请求详细信息 - 姓名、电话号码、区域、型号、条件、首选时间和备注 - 将与该合作伙伴共享，并且仅用于安排和进行评估。我们的隐私政策中对此进行了说明。

在发送任何内容之前
该工具首先返回请求的预览以及上面的共享通知。仅在客户审阅并明确同意后才会传输。在此之前，该工具仅返回预览。

ChatGPT 内没有付款
该应用程序仅查找估价并提交免费评估请求。 ChatGPT 中不存在付款、结账、订购或购买商品的行为。所有数字均为不具约束力的估计值；最终价格是在亲自检查车辆后商定的。这就是C2B——商店从客户那里购买车辆，而不出售车辆。

二手商品经销商许可：神奈川县公安委员会第452790009540号
电话：+81 50-3637-3699（每日开放，日本标准时间 9:00-21:00）

plugin_asdk_app_6a0ccec2e2cc819184dcad41.productIntroEn: Realistimo (Реалистимо) helps you find real property listings in Bulgaria — apartments, houses, offices, and more — directly in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ccec2e2cc819184dcad41.longDescription:
Realistimo (Реалистимо) helps you find real property listings in Bulgaria — apartments, houses, offices, and more — directly in ChatGPT.

Describe what you're looking for in English or Bulgarian (city, neighborhood, budget, sale or rent). The app shows interactive maps with neighborhoods, photos, prices in euros, and links to the full listings on Realistimo.

Good for: 
• Searching for houses and apartments for sale or rent in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora and other cities; 
• Filtering by location and deal type (sale / rent); 
• Viewing details and opening the listing on Realistimo for more information.

Data comes from public listings on realistimo.com. The app does not show broker phone numbers or personal contact details — use the official listing page on Realistimo to get in touch.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0ccec2e2cc819184dcad41.longDescriptionZh:
Realistimo (Реалистимо) 可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 中查找保加利亚的房地产列表 - 公寓、房屋、办公室等。

用英语或保加利亚语描述您要寻找的东西（城市、社区、预算、出售或出租）。该应用程序显示交互式地图，其中包含社区、照片、欧元价格以及 Realistimo 上完整列表的链接。

适合： 
• 寻找索非亚、普罗夫迪夫、瓦尔纳、布尔加斯、鲁塞、旧扎戈拉等城市待售或出租的房屋和公寓； 
• 按地点和交易类型（销售/租赁）过滤； 
• 查看详细信息并打开 Realistimo 上的列表以获取更多信息。

数据来自 realistimo.com 上的公开列表。该应用程序不显示经纪人电话号码或个人联系方式——请使用 Realistimo 上的官方列表页面进行联系。
